title: Monsterella Fantasy Makeup
description: Step into the monstrous world of beauty with "Monsterella Fantasy Makeup". This spookily engaging game lets you work your makeover magic on three iconic cartoon characters. In Frankie's unit, electrify her look with eerie eyeshadows, neon lipstick, shockingly cool hairstyles, and otherworldly outfits. Next, embrace Clawdeen's earthy mystique with jewel-toned makeup and howl-inducing wardrobe choices. Finally, express Draculaura's vamp chic vibe with dramatic makeup and goth-glam ensembles.

title: Save the crop
description: Save the Crop is an exciting arcade game where you control a tractor to rescue crops from fire! ?? Quickly cut and collect crops before they burn, then stack and sell them to earn money. Use your earnings to upgrade your tractor, buy storage houses, and explore new fields. Navigate using joystick controls and master the art of saving and farming in this fast-paced, action-packed game!

title: Lingo Dreams
description:
Learn English while playing
Lingo Dreams is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that helps you memorize English words through matching exercises. Find the correct pairs between your native language and English to complete each level.

Perfect for beginners, kids, or anyone who wants to expand their vocabulary while having fun.

title: Pipe Connect
description: Pipe Connect is a brilliant puzzle solver with an acute attention to detail and a sharp mind. Their function is to join dispersed pipe segments on a grid to provide a continuous water flow path from beginning to end. They must rotate and position pipes of different shapes, such as straight lines, elbows, and T-junctions, within a set amount of time or space as the puzzles get harder. Obstacles such as various sources, restricted routes, or challenging layouts are specific to each level.

title: Hamster Combo IDLE
description: Upgrade your stock market hamster! A new Idle clicker, thanks to which you will learn a lot about cryptocurrency exchanges. Dig up the crypt and upgrade your hamster.

title: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2
description: The beloved classic returns! In Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2, connect matching butterflies in this beautifully refreshed game,  featuring new wing colors, enhanced animations, updated UI, and countless levels to complete . Can you clear each level before time runs out? Collect coins to unlock new backgrounds and stunning butterfly wings in the updated shop! A relaxing, fun puzzle for all ages!

title: Butterfly Ear Cuff Jewelry
description: Butterfly Ear Cuff Jewelry is a captivating game for jewelry enthusiasts that takes you into a virtual designer's studio. Create stunning butterfly earcuffs with customizable shapes, metal colors, and gemstones.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Plant Merge: Zombie War
description: In the chaotic world of Merge Plant Zombie War, arm your garden with strategic merges to fend off relentless zombie hordes! Master upgrades, deploy special abilities, and outsmart waves of undead foes in this addictive merge-tower defense adventure. Will your botanical army prevail in the ultimate war for survival? Dive in and merge your way to victory!

title: Animal Royal
description:
"The ultimate player versus player game allows players to engage in battles against their opponents using unique animals."
You'll be challenged to use your wits and strategy to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious.
Animal Royal is a game that features a wide variety of animals and birds, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses.
Your goal is to protect your meat from being eaten by your opponent's animals while sending your animals to eat as much meat as possible to win the battle.

title: My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look
description: Welcome to the My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look game. Cottagecore fashion is inspired by farm life, it is very impractical for doing chores around the farm! Princess Elsa, Anna, and Ariel are best friends planning to try something special. Get ready to explore the Cottagecore fashion style along with them to create the cutest looks!

title: Puzzle Lab
description: Tap connected blocks to clear them! If any blocks are left, you will lose life. The game ends when your life reaches 0. You can use placed special bombs by tapping them.

title: Juicy Match
description: Tired of candies? Dive into Juicy Match and explore a world of natural, fresh, and juicy delights! You run the best Juice Bar in town, where you match a variety of fruits, from tropical to classic, to create the perfect juice blends. Your cheerful friend, Tiki will guide you with tips and tricks. Match three or more identical fruits to juice them and complete levels. Create chain reactions for extra bonuses and points. Enjoy a refreshing, juicy adventure with Juicy Match!

title: Sprunki Monster Music Beats
description: Sprunki Monster Music Beats is a music game where popular characters create unique compositions. Combine sounds, create melodies, and enjoy!

title: Vex 9
description:
Vex 9 is here- the next evolution in the legendary stickman platformer series! Take your parkour skills to the limit as you run, jump, and slide your way through a brand-new set of Acts filled with dangerous traps, bombs, and other deadly surprises. 

For the first time ever, take to the skies with the powerful new Jetpack! Put your reflexes to the ultimate test in the all-new Challenge Mode! Can you conquer every challenge and become the ultimate Vex champion?

title: Noob Village Tower Defense
description: Dive into the dynamic world of a 2D platformer, where you play as a noob fighting for the survival of your village! Your main goal is to protect the village from endless waves of monsters appearing from an ominous portal. Control the tower manually: select shells, adjust the trajectory and shoot enemies one by one. Only your accuracy and tactics will help you survive the onslaught!

title: World War Brothers WW2
description:
⭐WORLD WAR BROTHERS⭐
World war brothers is a ww2 online first person shooter game. Play with your friends destroy enemy bases, capture the points. Traditional weapons, maps, and more will add soon. We need your feedbacks.
⭐ Features ⭐
- PvP multiplayer 8v8 Allies vs. Axis Teams
- Daily missions will come soon
- Omaha Beach, Pacific maps

title: PIZZA PUZZLE
description: Match the same pieces to complete the whole. If you are next to the same piece, the pieces will come together. Game over when there is no place to put pizza.

title: Worm Hunt
description: Worm Hunt is an .io game where you battle against other worms in a colorful online arena. Squirm around, picking up food and boosters to grow your worm bigger.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Atomic Merge 2048
description:
Atomic Merge 2048 is a fast-paced puzzle game where you drop and combine numbered blocks to reach the legendary 2048 tile! Strategically  drop blocks which fall on to center , merge identical numbers, and keep the pile from touching the red orbit. Watch out — one wrong drop could be the end!
Perfect for fans of casual, merge, and puzzle games. How high can you score before the stack overflows?

title: Wild Castle TD: Grow Empire
description: Wild Castle TD: Grow Empire is an excellent combination of tower and castle defense game! Build your defenses and use an excellent strategy to survive the monsters' onslaught.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: CloneUp - Stack Yourself
description:
CloneUp – Stack Yourself is a 2D pixel-art platformer where your greatest tool is… yourself!

Create clones, stack them, and use them as platforms to dodge spikes, reach new heights, and make your way to the exit door.

In CloneUp – Stack Yourself, you’ll use copies of the main character to reach platforms and avoid deadly obstacles.

title: Idle Animal Anatomy
description: Idle Animal Anatomy is a clicker game where you can create living organisms from scratch. The goal of the game is to create an animal cell by cell, and this will make you feel like a scientist.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Furry Kung Fu
description: Furry Kung-Fu & Babushka is a humorous fighting game with fun cartoon graphics, where controlling Cat or Babushka you need to inflict the enemy a series of hand-to-hand strikes, managing to dodge the sinister ball and sausage, which every second flies at you. Engage in epic hand-to-hand combat with park troublemakers. Earn achievements, get coins, unlock player skins! Will you be able to throw enemy sausage back at them? How long can you hold out? It's time to find out!

title: Challenge Your Friends
description: Challenge yourself! With seven different games, you can experience thrilling moments whether you're playing solo or competing against your friends. Drunken Duel, Tug The Table, Stick Duel, Milk The Cow, and many more games are waiting for you! Plus, to make the competition even more fun, you can choose exciting dares to make  the matches unforgettable! For those who prefer solo play, 6 games are ready to keep you entertained! Step into this world of fun and enjoy the thrill of competition!

title: Kids Coloring
description: Children adore entertaining coloring activities, and this Coloring Game stands out as one of the finest free coloring books and painting apps designed for kids!

title: Knit Bears
description: Knit Bears is a cozy and colorful puzzle game where you help adorable teddy bears come to life by knitting them from soft yarn. Choose a bear, place it in the center, and matching yarn balls will start wrapping it up. Each teddy bear needs three yarns to be fully knitted, so plan your moves carefully. If the board fills with unfinished bears that can’t be completed, the game ends.

title: Color Brain Test Games
description: Color Brain Test Game is a ring puzzle game. Do you want to train your brain?  You love fun spinning circle puzzle games with simple and colorful gameplay. Play Color Brain Test Games now!

title: LABUBU MERGE CLICKER
description:
Enter the wacky world of Labubu and the Monster Crew — merge mischievous Labubus, unlock rare forms, and climb your way to the top!
Boom! Crash! Roar! The gang’s all here — how far can you go before the box overflows?

title: Coffee Craze - Sorting Game
description: Play Coffee Craze - Sorting Game free online and step into a lively café in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Sort colorful cups, match drinks by type, and think ahead in a satisfying logic puzzle that doubles as a quick brain game. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is fully mobile-friendly. Optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game perfect for quick breaks and clever sorting fun anytime.

title: Triple Sort 3D Home Design
description: Welcome to the world of Triple Sort 3D: Home Design, where matching meets decorating! Dive in the puzzle-solving with and begin crafting a virtual space of your dreams. Get ready to transform ugly and cluttered rooms  into clean and cozy spaces! Discover the perfect blend of challenges, creativity, and an epic makeover journey that awaits you!

title: Suitable Outfit Dressup
description: Suitable Outfit Dressup is a fashionable and exciting dress up game. If you are a big fan of fashion games, then you will surely enjoy this game! Try different dress styles, hairstyles to make your anime girl character stand out and show off your skills as a fashion line master in the game! Have fun playing!

title: Brainrot World Hole.io
description: Brainrot World Hole.io is a hilarious casual hole game packed with chaotic brainrot energy and funny Italian meme vibes. Control a growing hole and dive into a crazy world where swallowing everything in sight is the key to victory. Move around the map and collect objects smaller than your hole.

title: Space Cleaner
description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

title: Sprunki Phase Brainrot
description: Sprunki Phase Brainrot is a chaotic and hilarious reskin of the original Sprunki game, now powered by Italian Brainrot energy! Play as absurd meme legends like Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Frigo Camelo, La Vaca Saturno, Lirili Larila, Burbaloni Luliloli, and many more. Run, jump, and lose your mind through surreal levels packed with brainrot humor, crazy visuals, and unpredictable madness. Enjoy custom sound effects and music that match each character’s bizarre personality!

title: Idle Money Factory
description: Money Factory is a fast-paced clicker game with strategic elements where you build and expand your financial empire by optimizing money production lines. Start with a simple setup and gradually grow by upgrading equipment, unlocking new production areas, and enhancing efficiency to skyrocket your profits.

title: Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts
description: Play Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts, a free and addictive sorting game! Train your brain by stacking nuts of the same color. Simple yet challenging, it's the perfect casual game to relax and sharpen your logic skills. Play now and start sorting!

title: Real Driving Simulator
description: Real Driving Simulator is a realistic driving simulation game that lets you fully enjoy the thrill of driving and racing! In this game, you can unblock various vehicles and drive them through cities and tracks. Experience the real feel of being behind the wheel.

title: My Arcade Center
description: My Arcade Center is a fast-paced management game where you build and expand your own arcade. Earn tokens by day, upgrade machines by night, hire staff, use coin bots, and handle freeloaders and vandals. Unlock new machines, optimize layouts, manage customer behavior, and progress through 9 handcrafted maps for long-term growth.

title: Spot Differences Bird Adventure
description: Spot Differences: Bird Adventure is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you find differences between two bird pictures. Look carefully, tap the changes, and complete each level before time runs out. Enjoy colorful birds, beautiful scenes, and simple controls. Perfect for all ages who love easy and brain-teasing games.

title: Octopus Invasion
description: Dive into the ocean and control a hungry octopus on its journey to become the ultimate sea predator! Hunt fish, evolve new abilities, and unlock deeper, more dangerous zones in this addictive underwater adventure.

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: sprunki character maker OC
description: The Sprunki Character Maker OC is an interactive tool that allows users to create their own unique characters within the Sprunki universe. Featuring a wide range of customization options, assets, and design tools, it empowers players to craft characters that match the game’s distinctive art style and themes. This experience encourages creativity, self-expression, and deeper engagement with the Sprunki community

title: Fly Fly Fly
description:
Fly Fly Fly is a Flappy Bird alike game, where you have to fly through 30 different levels, avoiding obstacles an collecting berries. 
If you hit the ground it will be game over, if you crash on one of the earth worms around the level, you will lose a life. If you lost all your lives, it's game over. You can restore your health collecting the berries you will find around the level. Do your best and beat all the 30 levels and show the world what you really are!

title: Dino Idle Park
description: Dino Idle Park is a relaxing leisure real estate tycoon where you create and develop a dinosaur amusement park. Expand plots, release and display dinosaurs, optimize queues and parks, hire staff, and upgrade investments to increase funds and income. Balance safety, visitor happiness, and research to keep the park thriving even when youre away.

title: Shape Transform Race
description: Shape Transform Race is a fun racing game that can be played in reaction-based 1 and 2 player game modes. You can play the game against bots or against your friend. Always be the fastest by choosing the right vehicle for the terrain! You can unlock new vehicles and characters with the coins you earn from the races.

title: City Drift Racing
description: "City Drift Racing" is an atmospheric racing arcade game where crazy competitions await you on the streets of the metropolis.

title: Catch a Fish Obby
description: Catch a Fish Obby is a chaotic collector raider set in a bright obby world full of Fish and Brainrot Fish characters. Build a money making base with your favorite sea creatures, sneak into rival bases to steal their fish, and protect your own tank from greedy bots and other players.

title: Geometry Flap
description:
Enter a world of bold outlines, sharp corners, and pure reflex. In Geometry Flap, you control a shapeshifting arrow darting through a black-and-white maze of geometric chaos. Tap to flap, weave through deadly gates, and dodge precision traps in this high-speed gauntlet of skill.

Features:
One mistake = instant crash.
Simple to play, brutally hard to master.
Unlock dozens of slick arrow skins.

Will you survive the rhythm of geometry?
Challenge your reflex. Flap to glory.

title: Join Clash Color Button
description: Are you ready for a game of choices and surprises? Color Button is the game for you! You need to pick the right door and make it to the end safely. But be careful, each door can lead to a different challenge or enemy. You have to use your skills and strategies to avoid traps and obstacles. Teamwork is the key to success in this game. Color Button is an exciting game that tests your judgment and decision-making skills. Do you have what it takes to beat the enemies and reach the end?

title: Crazy Traffic Control
description:
You control the traffic in the most realistic, craziest one-touch traffic game!
Put your timing and skills to the test with:

- realistic traffic 
- realistic acceleration   
- realistic stopping times!
- trains
- cows
- pedestrians

Unbelievably absorbing and incredibly fun — clear the intersections with Crazy Traffic Control!

title: Taylor Dress Studio Preppy & Wild West & Glam
description: Welcome to the dress-up game, in which the pop diva tries on three completely different fashionable looks: a youthful preppy bow, a cowboy outfit and a glamorous stage look. In addition, you can experiment with hairstyles and change the makeup of the heroine. Complete the images with accessories: glasses, hats and jewelry. Choose clothes and combine elements from different sets to create delicate, daring or superstar bows. Turn Taylor into an icon of any style!

title: Warping Bat
description: In Warping Bat you have to bounce from spring to spring in order to collect all of the coins in the level which will then open the exit gate. Face more than twenty levels, avoiding obstacles, and bouncing around each level! Try your best and see if you have what it takes to complete the game in its entirety!

title: Colored Bricks
description: Colored Bricks is a fun and simple endless game. There are colorful bricks and one on the top. You should move that one to the right or left. When it hits the same color brick, it will destroy all bricks of the row. The challenge is to improve your high score in the limited time that you have! Some bricks have extra time if you destroy them.

title: Woody Hexa
description: Woody Hexa is a visually engaging puzzle game that challenges players to complete 250 levels by strategically arranging hexagonal blocks by color. With simple drag-and-drop controls and increasingly complex layouts, each level tests your logic and spatial awareness. Combining relaxing gameplay with clever merging mechanics, Woody Hexa offers a satisfying brain workout perfect for all ages.

title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
description: "Hyper Cars Ramp Crash" is a 3D stunt and crash simulation game with realistic physics and graphics. You can perform incredible stunts in many different modes with great looking cars. 7 different super-sport car models are waiting in the garage for you to try them. Open world, stunt modes and fall mode can be played in 1-player and 2-player modes.

title: Horror Playtime Room Escape
description: Challenge your brain to break through the fog of horror. In Horror Playtime - Room Escape you will enter a mysterious story. You spend your birthday with Ye Chen on the roof of a building. The strange woman suddenly appeared and trapped you in a horrible room. Enter many rooms full of puzzles and horror! Use your brain to solve hidden things and uncover the truth of horror stories. Every detail in the room is full of mystery.

title: Data Diggers
description:
Merge USBs, choose blocks, download data, get money,and buy USBs
Merge the USBs for increased efficiency.

Dig Data in Data Diggers, actually you rather download Data with your USBs.
The higher the GB amount of your USB, the faster you can download the data.

title: Build A Queen 2025
description: In Build a Queen 2025, you will embark on a fun journey to become a real queen. You will need to make your way through different platform levels with your opponents. Choose outfits, skin colors, and more according to your goals. Dress up in the most glamorous queen look, meet the prince, and win. You can collect money to unlock more dance steps.

title: Crazy Zoo Swipe - Match 3 Puzzle Game
description: Welcome to the Crazy Zoo. Connect the same animals here to eliminate them. The more you connect, the greater the chance of obtaining powerful props. If you encounter a difficult level after that, use it wisely to let it burst out with unimaginable magic. Energy light waves, successfully pass the level!

title: Tile Hex World: Red vs Blue
description:
Build and destroy!
Take part in an exciting battle between Blue and Red! This time, you will have to extract resources, construct buildings and even build entire islands!
To ​​fight the enemy, you will need to build a path to his island.
Chop down trees, process resources into building hexes, with which you can expand your territory!
The winner is the one who captures the enemy flag and subjugates the enemy army!

title: Wood Color Block
description: Step into the colorful puzzle world of Wood Color Block, where strategy and quick thinking collide. Slide vibrant blocks into place, match them with their crushers, and clear the board before time runs out. With each level, the puzzles grow more challenging, pushing your skills to the limit.

title: Spin Thru
description:
Fit the piece perfectly before the hole arrives!
Tap to rotate! Swipe left or right to flip!
When it’s ready, swipe up to send it through the hole.
Keep succeeding in a row to trigger Fever!
During Fever, easier puzzles will appear for a limited time!

title: Draw Weapon Fight Party
description: In Draw Weapon - Fight Party, you can draw your own weapons. Feel free to write your weapon, but keep an eye on the amount of ink left. Your creativity determines your combat style. Enter the 3D battle arena and fight against other opponents in an action-packed showdown. Draw precisely, craft the ultimate weapon, and crush your opponents to become the ultimate warrior.

title: Clicker Knights vs Dragons
description: Clicker Knights vs Dragons is a fast-paced clicker game in which you assemble a team of heroes to defeat the evil monsters, as well as the dragons! Developer Clicker Knights vs Dragons is developed by Playtouch.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Zumble Story
description: Explore every corner of the jungle, create combinations and shoot colorful marbles. With each level, face unique challenges and utilize powerful boosters to enhance your skills. Unlock exciting chapters, conquer obstacles, and experience a vibrant journey full of surprises!

title: Indian Suv Offroad Simulator
description: Welcome to the adrenaline-pumping world of Indian SUV Offroad Simulator, where rugged landscapes and challenging terrains await the daring off-road enthusiast. Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding adventure as you take the wheel of powerful Indian SUVs designed to conquer the toughest off-road trails.

title: Overtide.io
description: Overtide.io is a fast-paced first-person shooter game that puts your reflexes and strategy to the test in action-packed modes like Free-For-All and Kill Confirmed. Battle through intense maps, customize your loadout, and earn upgrades as you climb the ranks.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Mojicon Emoji Connect
description:
A fast, fun twist on classic Onet puzzles!
Get ready to match and relax with Mojicon: Emoji Connect – the cheerful tile-linking puzzle bursting with personality!
Connect identical emoji tiles, clear the board, and enjoy satisfying spark effects with every perfect match.
With hundreds of cute icons, calming backgrounds, and rewarding combos, Mojicon delivers endless relaxing fun for all ages.
Play anywhere, anytime – no downloads, just pure emoji joy!

title: Nubik in the Monster World
description:
Nubik saved the kittens, but the monsters are back! Evil Huggy has kidnapped them again!
Now Nubik has new weapons: AK-47, M16, grenade launcher, machine gun, and shotguns!
Help him rescue the kittens, collect loot, earn coins, upgrade, blast TNT, and escape traps. Even his friend gets captured—help Nubik save him too!

title: Put the fruit together!
description: A game in the genre of "Connect the Balls" and "2048". Stack identical fruits to combine them into a new larger fruit! The game has incredibly beautiful and cute graphics, nice music accompaniment and addictive gameplay!

title: Egg Dash
description: Crack the code and dash your way to victory in Egg Dash, an egg-citing version of the rhythm-based game genre! Jump, dodge, and conquer egg-cellent obstacles in this fast-paced adventure.

title: Arrow Wave
description: Explore a world where a wave moves through various obstacles, overcoming challenges along the way. Test your reaction and perseverance!

title: Hippo Supermarket
description: Meet Jack Ma, a cute hippo who dreams of opening his own supermarket. But he doesn't know how to do it. He needs your help to make his dream come true.In this fun and addictive game, you need to merge the same items to get higher-level items, and then sell them to earn money. The more money you make, the more you can help Jack Ma build his store.

title: Labubu Adventure
description:
Dive into a world of Labubu characters. If you are looking for an amazing adventure, help the little Labubu to complete all the levels and collect coins through the fantasy world.
Whether you want to elevate your gaming skills or just look for simple fun, you can always find something that fits your type.

title: Kung-Fu Little Animals
description: In this game you will become the new assistant of the Great Master. Your task is to teach funny and dexterous animals the art of kung fu. With simple clicks, you will train your newly minted students so that they become worthy successors of the Great Master's work. Passing the game, you will discover new funny animals, as well as new beautiful and unusual locations. Join the kung fu team and have fun teaching the little animals martial arts!

title: Strykon
description:
Strykon is a mobile FPS game with exciting missions and battles. Play different modes like Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Free-for-All, where your goal is to survive.
Choose from many weapons, like pistols, rifles, shotguns, and snipers. Each gun has its own style. Enjoy great graphics, realistic sound, and easy controls. Earn rewards with the Battle Pass to keep the game interesting. Whether you complete missions or fight enemies, this shooter is full of action anytime, anywhere!

title: My Castle. Merge & Story
description:
My Castle: Merge & Story is a relaxing merge 2 puzzle game set in a warm and atmospheric medieval world of renewal, mystery, and self-discovery. Merge items, restore and decorate an ancient castle, and follow the journey of a young princess who chooses a new path in life.
This calm offline merge adventure combines cozy gameplay, castle restoration, and a story about starting over — far from royal expectations, closer to one’s true self.
Restore and Decorate a Forgotten Castle

title: Building Mods For Minecraft
description: Building Mods For Minecraft is the ultimate game for those who love to build and fight. If you’re a Minecraft fan looking for a new adventure, this game takes the building mechanics of Minecraft to the next level, combining construction with action. You’ll have access to a wide range of building tools and guns.

title: Timberland Arrange Puzzle Game
description:
Arrange the animals and color them! А refreshing reinterpretation of classic Tag and Sudoku. Assemble a logical puzzle by finding intersections between different types of hints. Enjoy colorful hand-drawn graphics, fascinating sounds of nature and cheerful cries of animals!

It may seem that the game is quite simple. However, level by level you will dive deeper into the rabbit hole, discover new mechanics, and the number of combinations will increase reaching hundred thousand!

title: Traffic Parking
description: Traffic Parking is a car puzzle game to park the car into the garage of the house, the car is on the road looking for a way to go home by avoiding other cars. Sometimes there are rocks on the road that must be removed so that the car can pass through. You also need tricks at certain levels to make the road passable for cars.

title: Sand Blast - Block Game
description:
Welcome to Sand Blast, a fresh and relaxing twist on classic block puzzle games!
Relax your mind with Sand Blast — a satisfying and strategic puzzle game built around flowing sand mechanics.
Whether you're into relaxing brain games, casual offline fun, or smart logic challenges, Sand Blast delivers a fresh experience you can enjoy anytime, anywhere — no WiFi or internet required.

title: Nuclear Day Survival
description:
Can you survive in a world where there was a nuclear explosion? There is radiation, hunger, disease and suffering around you. Your goal is to escape the dying city and find the love of your youth. A unique atmosphere and a heart-piercing plot. Uncover the mystery of the missing documents and make a choice: save the people around you or leave them to die..

Peculiarities:
— Crafting system
— Unique plot
— Exploring an interesting world

title: Block Blaster Puzzle
description: Aim for high scores or complete level objectives. Rotate and arrange blocks to clear rows and columns while enjoying stunning visuals. Each perfect move brings satisfaction, challenging you to beat your best and master each puzzle!

title: Squid Escape But Blockworld
description: You need to escape from the Squid competition, but while running away, you fell into the Block world. It’s a bit hard to escape from the Block world, but don’t stop and keep running. Never stop running until you reach the purple portal. Don’t forget to collect the money you see on the way. Be careful of the big monsters chasing you from behind; they want to catch you, and if they do, you’ll lose.

title: Mindblow
description: Get ready for a mind-teasing adventure in Mindblow, the ultimate word puzzle game that challenges your vocabulary and logic skills. Explore hundreds of fun and engaging levels — from simple to truly tricky — all designed to keep your brain sharp and entertained. Play for free on desktop or mobile, uncover hidden words from beautiful images, and enjoy new levels added every month. Think you have what it takes to become a true word master?

title: Clean House: Clearing trash and dirt
description:
Welcome to an exciting game world where everyone can enjoy the process of cleaning. The further you advance, the more garbage accumulates, and your vacuum cleaner faces a real challenge. But don't despair! Collect all the garbage and take it to the garbage truck, earning money that can be spent on improving your vacuum cleaner.

Clean and declutter your homes to restore them to their original beauty!

title: Feet Doctor Urgency Care
description:
As a podiatrist in this medical simulation game, treat various urgent foot conditions and save patients. As a doctor, you will take care of the patient's feet.
Use all tools to cure them.

title: Bubble Merge 2048
description: Welcome to Bubble Merge 2048, where classic 2048 meets exciting bubble-blasting action! Shoot, merge, and blast through puzzles filled with colourful bubbles and challenges. Match numbers and colours, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and smash obstacles as you journey through this one-of-a-kind adventure.

title: Kawaii Friends: Tiles Matcher
description: Kawaii Friends: Tiles Matcher is a delightful puzzle game where you match adorable tiles featuring cute characters and vibrant colors. Your goal is to pair three identical tiles.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Monster Merge Legends Alive
description: Merge monsters! Choose more points! Drop monsters into the playing area. If they match, they will merge and become monsters of a higher rank. Your task is to unite as many monsters as possible and accumulate as many points as possible!

title: Funny Fever Hospital
description: Join Ruby, a schoolgirl battling a unique lung virus, in Funny Fever Hospital! Diagnose, operate, and dress her for the cosplay competition. Cure her, and she'll thank you with a dazzling dress-up session! Experience medical fun and fashion in one pet-tastic game!

title: Sprunki Easter Coloring

Follow the latest fashion trends with these celebrities and create your own fashion clothes for next spring season. Browse their wardrobe to pick suitable outfits and costumes. Join and help them to welcome their favorite season.

title: Shop Sorting Xmas
description: Love a well-organized, neatly arranged space? Then Shop Sorting Xmas is the perfect game for you! Step into a delightful Christmas-themed puzzle game where you’ll sort and arrange festive items in a magical Christmas toy shop. In this captivating holiday sorting game, find and match identical toys and Christmas decorations, organizing them on the shelves. Your goal is to gather three identical items together to create a triplet and clear the shelves.

title: Love Tile Trio
description: Welcome to the Valentine's Day tile matching game! Your mission is to match and clear tiles from the board. Tap a tile and move it to an empty space or a spot with a matching tile. If no matches are available or there's no room, you'll need to try again. With a countdown timer and tricky puzzles, can you beat the Love Tile challenge?

title: Stickman Guys Defense
description:
Stickman Guys Defense is an action-packed tower defense game where you must protect your base from endless waves of enemies! Command a team of brave stickman warriors, place them strategically, and upgrade their abilities to stop the invasion. From archers to sword fighters, build the ultimate defense and survive each level!

Can you defend your land and become the ultimate Stickman commander?

title: Xiblba Match
description: Xiblba Match Seasons 1 is one of the new Match 3 games from the creators of the SIDM GAMES STUDIO, Xiblba Match Seasons. The most beautiful Xiblba Match. The second sequel features a BIG content update with new levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy!

title: Crash Car Parkour Simulator
description:
Test the cars in a real crash test!

You need to get to the finish line, but on the way you will meet many obstacles. Car presses, huge hammers and much more will try to crush you and turn your car into trash. Show real car driving skills.

title: Tung Tung Sahur Coloring Book
description:
Unleash your creativity with the Italian Tung Coloring Book, a hilarious and surreal coloring experience inspired by the viral Italian Brainrot meme phenomenon. Featuring absurd characters like Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, and Bombardiro Crocodilo, this coloring book offers a unique blend of humor and art.
Each page presents a bizarre and whimsical scene, inviting you to add your personal touch with colors.

title: Find It - Find The Differences
description: Find It is an engaging puzzle game that tests your observation skills as you search for subtle differences between two nearly identical images. With colorful visuals and beautifully designed scenes, each level presents a fresh challenge. Whether you're spotting tiny details or uncovering hidden objects, Find It will keep you entertained and focused. Hone your attention to detail, enjoy the excitement of finding every difference, and experience hours of fun suitable for all ages!

title: Brainrot-A Difference Challenge
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Brainrot – A Difference Challenge, the ultimate photo puzzle game! Spot subtle differences between two eerily similar Italian "brainrot" images across a series of mind-bending levels. Each pair of pictures will challenge your focus, attention to detail, and visual memory. Can you find them all before time runs out?

title: Sudoku Brain Blocks
description: Sudoku Brain Blocks is a relaxing yet addictive online puzzle game that blends classic Sudoku logic with block-fitting challenges (Tetris style). Drag and drop various shaped blocks onto a 9×9 grid to complete full rows, columns, or 3×3 squares to clear the board and earn high scores. Use strategy and planning to avoid running out of space and test your brain with every move!

title: Merge Flow
description: "Merge Flow"  is a casual puzzle game, by the board of 5*7 number squares and the bottom n +/- operators, each of the blocks have numbers, use the operator to make the number square +/-n, the same number will be combined into a +1 number, while obtaining the corresponding score. When the operators run out, the round ends.

title: Labubu and Treasures: Fun Adventure
description: Collect bright combinations, pass hundreds of levels together with amazing characters from the Labubu universe! In this exciting Match-3 puzzle you will find bright adventures, interesting puzzles and fluffy magic.

title: Vortex Ball
description: Roll through an ever-changing, vibrant tunnel filled with deadly obstacles and tricky hurdles. Test your reflexes as you dodge, weave, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced infinite runner. Collect gems along the way and unlock 27 unique balls from the shop. With only 2 balls to start, every gem counts. The tunnel never ends, the colors keep shifting, and the challenge only gets harder. How far can you go? Compete for the highest score and prove your skills!

title: Everything is in place: Rare finds
description:
Welcome to a peaceful haven for everyone who loves aesthetics and perfectionism! If you find genuine joy in perfect symmetry, neatly organized items, and pristine spaces, this meditative puzzle game is designed specifically for you.
You will step into the shoes of not just an organizer, but a true connoisseur of beauty. Each level presents a new, unique location cluttered with a variety of intriguing objects.

title: Soccer Arena X
description: Soccer Arena X is an exciting football game that delivers dynamic matches, simple controls, and colorful arcade gameplay. Every match is fast, fun, and full of energy, giving you the ultimate multiplayer football experience. As you progress, you’ll collect coins and gems to unlock powerful abilities like freeze, lightning, super kick, or a giant head, adding a bright and entertaining arcade style to the gameplay. Step onto the pitch, score goals, and become a football star!

title: Stacktris 2048
description: Stacktris 2048 is a combination of the 2048 and Tetris games in 3D. Challenge everyone and score as many points as possible!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Noob vs Zombie Apocalypse: shooting pro
description:
Post-apocalypse! Noob finds himself alone against zombies. Passing levels, he accumulates coins and picks up weapons.
There is a grenade launcher, a pistol, an uzi, a shotgun, a machine gun, a laser pistol, a rifle, a laser rifle - and so on!

Noob vs Zombie Apocalypse: shooting pro is an epic noob game in the world, similar to minecraft fnaf. Noob shoots at zombies with a variety of weapons like a rambo. Noob miner starts his fighting fnaf survival!

There are 60 levels and 15 bosses in total!

title: Italian Brainrot Puzzle
description: In the game Italian Brainrot Puzzle you have 16 puzzles with pictures of Italian Brainrot characters. Assemble them by shifting to position the pieces.To change drag parts up to another position. Complete a level, go to the next. In each level you have limited time for which you need to complete it. Enjoy this game!

title: Fat Cat Life
description: In this game you will have a bunch of cats to choose from, a huge selection of hats and a variety of tasks. From the simplest to the most difficult.

title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
description: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

title: Basket Swap
description: Slide into the gray blocks to help you position the ball and grid correctly. If you're stuck, click on the arrow in the bottom left corner to undo your last move, or press R to restart the level.

title: Dynamons Connect
description:
Dive into the exciting world of Dynamons Connect! This fun and engaging game with adorable, colorful characters helps improve focus and visual perception.
Match identical tiles by connecting them with a path that has no more than two turns to clear the board. With endless levels, the challenge never stops!

title: Mega Fall Ragdoll Simulator
description: Mega Fall Ragdoll Simulator is a casual game where you unleash chaos by dropping a ragdoll from towering structures to maximize bone-crunching impact. Experience realistic physics as you strategize your way through intricate levels, earning coins to unlock skins and enhance your ragdoll's appearance. Brace yourself for an ultimate destruction experience like no other!

title: Jump Man
description: A highly addictive endless jumper with a super cute but mischievous character! Chain combos and score as high as you can!

title: 2048 Number Match
description: Indulge your brain and enjoy puzzle-solving and number-matching. Achieve the highest possible score and boast about your brain-power!

title: Skribbl.io
description: Skribbl.io is one of the most popular IO art drawing games out there. If you've ever enjoyed games like Pictionary, this one is right up your alley.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Roblox Halloween Costume Party
description: Roblox Halloween Costume Party is the ultimate dress-up experience! Create your spookiest, funniest, or most creative Halloween looks using a variety of Roblox-inspired costumes and accessories. Mix and match outfits to stand out at the party, and get into the Halloween spirit by competing in costume contests with friends. Show off your unique style in this festive and fun-filled game!

title: Love Archer
description: Welcome to "Love Archer" - an addictive game where you, as the cheerful Cupid, use your archery skills to bring together all the lovers! Solve puzzles, throw arrows at creatures, and they will find themselves in a magical garden, possessed by love. Are you ready, little hero? Shoot arrows of love to create different loving couples. Even an orc and a human can become happy parents. Combine them and watch love win!

title: GT Drift Most Wanted
description:
Drift your way around each level and hit all the snow piles while avoiding barriers. With responsive controls and a focus on timing and precision, players must master their drifting skills to clear each stage and become the ultimate Drift Master.
In this game, players can purchase different cars, each offering a unique driving experience. There’s no customization—just pick your favorite car and hit the track!

title: Toytopia
description: Toytopia is a cozy merge-and-repair adventure where you combine art items to craft materials and restore broken toys. Every toy has its own look and challenge, so you’ll keep unlocking new fixes and surprises. Relaxing, creative, and gently strategic.

title: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek
description: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek is an exciting and fast-paced hide-and-seek adventure game set in a colorful yet dangerous rainbow world. Step into this thrilling role-playing experience, choose your role, and get ready for an unforgettable adventure.

title: Dig & Flow - Save Water
description:
Dig through the sand and guide flowing elements through level labyrinths to collect all the stars. Use element physics, plan the route carefully, and control the streams to activate mechanisms and open new paths. Simple controls make the game easy to understand from the first seconds, but each level requires more logic and precision.

Different elements appear throughout the levels — water, lava, and hot steam. Each behaves differently and opens new ways to solve puzzles.

title: Turret Gunner
description:
You will find yourself in a thrilling air battle simulation, filled with exciting moments and countless enemy targets. You’ll be able to maneuver, shoot, and fight virtual opponents, experiencing the true adrenaline rush of an airstrike.

This captivating journey into the world of aviation will leave unforgettable impressions on fans of extreme action and flying. Feel like a real pilot and enjoy the excitement of aerial combat!

title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo
description: Welcome to Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo, a unique and immersive game that lets you unleash your inner tattoo artist. This isn't just any game; it's your gateway to a world where art meets relaxation, and where your creativity can truly shine. Prepare to immerse yourself in the satisfying and intricate process of tattooing, all at the tip of your fingers!

title: 2248 Musical
description: Once you start playing it, you will absolutely get addicted to these 2048 puzzle games. designed with beautiful graphics and intuitive gameplay, making it a great choice for those who love number block puzzle games

title: Max Speed
description: Race shiny sports cars on thrilling 3D tracks full of jumps, stunts, and intense battles. Explore exciting locations with unique challenges, perform daring tricks, upgrade and customize your cars, and test your skills in fast-paced arcade races. Enjoy high-speed action, stunning visuals, and nonstop adrenaline right in your browser.

title: Murder Case Clue 3D
description: Murder Case Clue 3D is an exciting 3d escape game. You will play the role of detective, there was a murder recently, you need to find some clues and escape from this dangerous house. Be careful, good luck!

title: Virtual Neko Kitty Collector
description: Welcome to Virtual Neko: Kitty Collector, a casual cat game that you can play for free. Dive into a super cute world with cute kittens. Buy items, feed them, and earn red hearts to upgrade your cats' yard.

title: Color Nuts & Bolts Puzzle
description: Color Nuts & Bolts Puzzle is a fun and engaging puzzle game that challenges your spatial imagination and color-matching skills! Match colorful screws to their corresponding nuts and watch as your puzzle-solving skills bring vibrant images to life. Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers hours of brain-teasing fun with a visually satisfying reward at the end of each challenge. Test your logic, precision, and creativity in this unique puzzle-solving adventure!

title: Hide And Seek Horror Escape
description: Hide And Seek: Horror Escape is an asymmetric horror escape game. Abandoned schools and haunted hospitals, here's a lot of hidden secrets and treasures are waiting to be discovered. During the game, there are two identities for you to choose, hide or seek?

title: Save Her Tour
description: This complex and relaxing puzzle game you've read about has finally become a reality! Only the smartest can pass these brain teaser quizzes and save the girl! Each level will give you a scenario where you must use your ingenuity to solve the problem. If you mess up, it won't end well for our heroine. There are so many different challenges waiting to be solved. This is the best puzzle game ever! Solve interesting puzzles, protect the girl from harm, and experience the thrill of success.

title: Toy Assembly 3D
description:
Assemble a wide variety of brick buildings and scenes in this classic constructor game. Start as a baby builder and level your way up to increasingly complex construction sets. This relaxing and
satisfying game is sure to bring you back to the imagination and fun of your childhood!  Find the right piece and simply tap to add it to your build.  Get hands-on fun without the clutter or accidentally stepping on toys.

title: Funny Walk Fail Run
description: Funny Walk Fail Run is a fun-filled arcade action game with funny and magical gameplay! You will control a villain in the game to do challenges. But don't expect him to walk steadily, because he always falls and bumps in all sorts of funny positions! Your job is to help him navigate each step of the shaky road.

title: Tower Wars Arena
description: Fight in the arena in a unique strategy with elements of real-time strategies and tower defense! Capture the center, increase your army and destroy enemy towers. Upgrade units and spells to legendary levels to achieve victory!

title: Tanks. Race for survival
description: In this exciting tank game, you compete with other players to be the first to reach the finish line, destroying enemy towers along your way. Control powerful tanks, use tactical thinking and strategic maneuvers to overcome obstacles and defeat opponents. Carefully plan your route, avoiding enemy attacks and traps on the path to victory. The thrilling survival race begins here!

title: Stunt Rider
description: In this exciting game, you will take on the role of an experienced stuntman, performing daring stunts on your motorcycle at different levels. Unlock new levels and buy cool motorcycles in the Stunt Rider game.

title: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly
description: This is a first-person psychological horror game where you work night shifts in a small street kiosk. What seems like a normal job quickly turns into a nightmare: customers grow increasingly strange, and reality itself begins to warp. Some people just want to eat — others are only pretending to be human.

title: Secrets of Charmland
description:
● Unique gameplay: help Emma treat her friends by swapping and matching delicious sweets!
● Tons of match-3 levels filled with exciting elements, awesome boosters and explosive combinations!
● A world full of Charmland: discover all the magical places it has to offer!
● Fantastic characters: watch Emma making new acquaintances and helping them with their unusual quests.

title: Design With Me SuperHero Tutu Outfits
description: Welcome to Design With Me SuperHero Tutu Outfits. We all love superheroes very much! Likewise, our favorite princesses are inspired more by superhero tutu fashion. They planned to organize the fashion events under this theme. Join and help each princess to pick a suitable superhero tutu outfit. Play them and have fun!

title: Geometry Vibes Monster
description: Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you must dodge incoming obstacles, spikes, and battle against a variety of unique monsters. Each monster features distinct attack patterns that you must skillfully avoid. Your main goal is to navigate your spaceship as far as possible while surviving the onslaught of attacks.

title: Traffic Escape Puzzle
description: Come to enter a complex maze in the Traffic Escape Puzzle! In this exciting puzzle game, get your car out safely. Find the right time to exit the vehicle. Be careful to avoid traffic jams and collisions. To slide the vehicle and create a clear path for cars. Each level presents a new traffic maze. And traffic flows become more and more complex. Come to use your ingenuity and strategize. Cleverly arrange all cars on a complex maze of roads.

title: Purrfect Scoops
description:
Welcome to Purr-fect Scoops,
Run your own ice cream shop, serving up delightful cones and cups to a menagerie of animal customers. 
Choose from a variety of flavors.
Unlock new cups, flavors, and toppings to expand your menu and attract even more customers. 
Use power-ups like the Coin Multiplier and Tip Booster to maximize your profits and become the ultimate ice cream tycoon. 
With its charming visuals and addictive gameplay, Purr-fect Scoops is sure to delight your day.

title: The Drag Racing Challenge
description: Welcome to The Drag Racing Challenge game, an exciting new arcade racing game! Race through challenging missions, unlock and upgrade over 12 cars, and compete against opponents with customizable vehicles. Test your skills in realistic maps across five cities and enjoy smooth, high-quality racing. No fuel or time limits—just endless drag racing fun!

title: Phone Case Diy 5
description: Phone Case DIY 5 is a popular Art Game. For children who like this series very much, you must be eager to play this game! In this new DIY phone case game, we changed the style of the game, changing the previous 2D style to the current 3D style. At the same time, we have also added patterns, decorations, stickers, etc. that can be selected. At the same time, we have also added an album function, you can save your masterpieces to the album, and you can view your own artworks at any time.

title: Strawberry Shortcake BoardGames
description: Visit the BerryWorks cafeteria and play checkers, memory, tic-tac-toe, connecting pairs, and complete jigsaw puzzles with your friends.

title: Word Mine
description: Word Mine takes you on a thrilling journey where letters are your treasure! Dive into a world of scrambled chaos and uncover hidden words buried in the grid. With every move, you’ll strike gold, revealing secrets that push you closer to victory. Sharpen your mind, follow the clues, and let the adventure unfold—one word at a time!

title: Home Pin 2
description:
Welcome to chapter 2 of the Home Pin. Start your adventure of the pin world in the secret manor!

You want to protect the family? You want to create your own manor and restore the beautiful manor to its former glory? Play Home Pin 2: Family Adventure now - a unique pull pin game with a family storyline you can’t ignore. No more fake ads, this is the game you are looking for!

title: Panda Lu Treehouse
description: Hey, animal lovers! Enter the enchanting world of Panda Lu's Tree House, a super fun casual simulator that will warm your heart. In this game, you play as the caretaker of the adorable panda Lu. Your adventure begins by building a magnificent tree house, a cozy and vibrant home for your furry friend.

title: Race Clicker
description: Race Clicker is an action-packed idle clicker racing game that'll pump up your adrenaline. Customize, upgrade, and speed your way to victory. Each click pushes your limits, every upgrade unveils new possibilities, and each race dares you to click faster. Leave rivals in the dust and satisfy your need for speed with endless excitement. Start your engines and hit the track now!

title: Match Collection
description: Collect 3 of the same items from the shelf to erase them. When a shelf is empty, the shelf above it falls down. You can have up to 7 items, and when your hand is full, the game is over. When all items are erased, the stage is cleared.

title: Impostor Hook Master
description: Have you ever heard about "Ah, fresh meat" from a hero called butcher? Impostor Hook Master is a skillful hook arcade game with 3D Among Us game art animations. Each round you need to catch enemies from the opposite side and avoid being caught from them with your highest skills. Glad you will entertain with this match and be the 1st winner!

title: Mini Golf Battle
description: Mini Golf Battle is a casual sports puzzle where precision and timing decide the outcome. Your task is to sink the ball into the hole with the fewest strokes possible while navigating ramps, walls, and tricky obstacles. Special power-ups like Fire, Wing, and Spring shots add variety, letting you approach each course with unique strategies. Whether for short play sessions or longer runs, Mini Golf Battle delivers an engaging mix of relaxation and skillful play.

title: Sprunki Space Challenge
description: Get ready to soar through the stars in Sprunki Space Challenge an intergalactic online adventure where brave kids take flight to save the galaxy. This wild space ride throws you into the cockpit of a zippy space rover where danger lurks in every asteroid and rocket burst. But worry not: Sprunki is here to lead the charge. It is all about timing, reflexes, and sky-high jumps that send you sailing straight into the action.

title: Terra Craft World
description: Terra Craft World invites you to explore an open world where every decision shapes your journey. Begin an unforgettable adventure filled with discovery and creativity. This game perfectly blends exploration, building, and survival mechanics into one exciting experience. Whether you enjoy creating structures or overcoming environmental dangers, every moment feels rewarding and dynamic. Discover more craft and building experiences packed with creativity and exploration fun!

title: Stupidity Test
description: Stupidity Test is a quiz game that lets you find out how stupid you really are! Answer some simple logical questions that may include colors, shapes, and simple math and see how well you do.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Obby Pinata Party
description: Help the Obby guy to fight those pinatas and Explore the world. Choose from wide variety of weapons, collect coins and upgrade them. Make the pinatas give you every penny they have!

title: Pictures Riddle
description:
Guess 1 word based on shown 4 pictures
Discover what word can be related to pictures
Game has 2 modes: “Pictures” & “Riddles”
 
Features:
-     Simple & addictive gameplay
-     Challenging riddles
-     Hundreds of fun levels
-     …



** Credits:
-     Music by “Fred Patry”
-     Menu vector created by upklyak – www.freepik.com

title: Wild West Match
description: Embark on a captivating Wild West adventure with Bonnie! Explore iconic landscapes, face challenges, and uncover secrets in this thrilling journey. The frontier spirit awaits – join Bonnie on the quest for an unforgettable adventure!

title: Sudoku - Pin.Games
description:
Sudoku - PIN.GAMES is a polished, feature-rich take on the timeless number puzzle. Fill the 9×9 grid so that every row, column, and 3×3 block contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.

With six difficulty levels, smart hints, combo scoring, daily challenges, and five handcrafted visual themes, it offers a clean, relaxing, and logic-focused Sudoku experience for both casual players and puzzle lovers.

title: Jello Bubbles
description: Classic Match 3 Bubble Shooter Game with jello balls, challenges, a nice bird and a fantastic heroine. Enjoy with lots of fun levels travelling around the world.

title: Single Line Puzzle Drawing
description:
Sharpen your mind each day with fun single-line drawing puzzles — clever, captivating brain teasers that boost your cognitive skills one stroke at a time. Enjoy a relaxing and rewarding 20-minute mental workout!
Would you like a version tailored for an app store description or marketing banner?

title: Only Up Parkour 2
description: Only Up Parkour 2! is an exciting arcade game in which you have to overcome obstacles and conquer heights of 500M. Inspired by the popular game Your task is to guide the character through a vertical labyrinth full of various obstacles. You must react quickly, jump accurately and climb up dexterously to avoid crashing into obstacles and falling down. As you progress through the various levels, you will encounter increasing difficulty and new challenges such as Jumping platforms and obstacles.

title: Real Car Parking Simulator
description:
Get ready to test your driving skills in Real Car Parking Simulator. In the parking simulation game, you will face various parking challenges. With realistic controls and detailed environments,you’ll feel like you're actually behind the wheel. From parallel parking to tight garage spaces,
this game offers many parking challenges.

title: Crazy Fruit Merge
description: Looking for the perfect relaxing game? Sometimes all you need is a fun puzzle. Merge fruits, challenge your mind and use power-ups to keep the game flowing. Progress further and aim for the highest score!

title: Police Station
description: As the head of multiple police precincts, your mission is to boost the security rating in the district under your watchful eye. Begin your adventure by managing a modest police department, strategically hiring officers, and putting in the effort to cultivate a safer community

title: Greek Tower Stacker
description:
Build the tallest structure by stacking beautiful new floors. Each floor contains intricate pillars and arches reminiscent of the mighty Greek civilization.

Challenge yourself to create the most majestic tower in ancient history.

title: Jelly Block Puzzle
description: Dive into the fun with our vibrant jelly merging game! Explore a world filled with countless levels, merge jellies, use power-ups, and stay entertained. Challenge your brain and see how far you can go in this delightful, jelly-colored adventure!

title: Princess Rescue Fruit Connect
description: Begin a fruity puzzle adventure. Princess Rescue Fruit Connect is a delightful match puzzle game where your mission is to rescue a beautiful princess by matching fruits and solving tricky levels. Connect two identical fruits to eliminate them. But notice clearing the board before time runs out. All while progressing to rescue the princess.

title: Bubble Shooter Legend
description: Enjoy a fun shooting puzzle game in Bubble Shooter Legend. Use your shooting skills in this casual puzzle game. Your goal is to match bubbles of the same color. Make them explode and disappear to complete each level step by step. Match three or more bubbles of the same color by aiming and firing them to explode and eliminate them!

title: Unscrew Them All
description: Unscrew Them All is a challenging  puzzle game where players must strategically unscrew all the screws securing large wooden planks to the board. After removing each screw, place it into the correct open slot. Unscrew all the planks before time runs out to complete each level. Master every level to win the game!

title: Moon League Sports Season
description: Under the light of the full moon, three monster-girlfriends are preparing for the brightest sports competitions of the year - the Lunar League Championship. Help the girls choose stylish sports outfits, trendy hairstyles and bright makeup for each competition. Create unique sports looks: from elegant dresses for the opening ceremony to uniforms for training. Mix colors, accessories and shoes to make each monstro-athlete shine in her own way. The Lunar League is waiting for its champions!

title: My Farm life
description: My Farm life is a fun farm adventure simulator game. Plant fields, take care of animals, hire workers and build bigger barns. Harvest apples, wheat, tomatoes, eggplants and all your favorite fruits and vegetables. Raise all kinds of cute pets like your own farm dog, breed cows, sheep and hens for milk and eggs. Become the richest farming tycoon, sit back and enjoy!

title: Black Jump
description: Escape the war-torn planet in this dynamic jump-and-run game. Sprint through the desolate landscape, vanquish enemies, sidestep deadly traps, and gather valuable crystals.

title: Dirty Money The Rich Get Rich
description: Dirty Money: The Rich Get Rich is a money clicker relaxation game. You are permitted to make money by tapping. When you earn some money and level up on the corresponding level, you can speed up by upgrading in the Growth, using the Invest, and making the Assets. The more money you make, the more functions you can unlock and use. I hope you will complete the target and make 100 million!

title: Okay
description: Okay is a minimalist puzzle game where your goal is to clear every element from the board by drawing a single strategic line. Each line you draw interacts with the objects on screen — if it hits them correctly, they disappear. The challenge lies in predicting the trajectory and eliminating everything with just one attempt.

title: Stickman Mega Boss: Battles!
description: Battle hordes of Minecraft mobs! Buy awesome swords and helmets, or unbox them from cases. Take on mega-bosses, unlock different modes, and earn leaderboard points to become the best in this game!

title: Sprunki PopIt
description: Sprunki PopIt: The Ultimate Bubble-Popping Adventure! Get ready for hours of bubbly fun with Sprunki PopIt, the free-to-play online game that kids everywhere are going crazy for! It’s fast, colorful, and packed with exciting challenges. Your goal? Pop all the bubbles, dodge obstacles, and conquer level after level of pure popping chaos!

title: Tower Defenders
description: Fight the undead viking warriors and upgrade your defenses. Use the rewards you get for victories to your advantage. Hold out for as long as you can!

title: Shape Shift
description:
Shape Shift is a fast-paced arcade game set in colorful outer space. Pilot your spaceship through a field of moving geometric shapes and collect the correct targets to score points.

But stay sharp, the target shape or color constantly changes. One moment you must collect blue circles, the next moment it might switch to red triangles. Grab the right shapes and avoid the wrong ones as long as you can!

title: 10K
description: You start with 10,000 points and a blank map. Your objective is to retain the highest number of points by pinpointing five cities on the blank map.

title: PrismRoll 3D
description: PrismRoll 3D is a challenging puzzle game where you swipe to roll a 3D block across different tiles to reach the target hole. Navigate through fragile tiles, switches, teleporters, and split mechanics across 100 unique levels. Customize your block with different skins and shapes. Can you beat them all?

title: Wild West Match 3
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With its vibrant Western visuals and exciting challenges, this bubble shooter brings cowboy spirit to every pop!

title: Blocky Archer Run
description:
Draw, Aim, and Loose!

Dash through challenging environments in this fast-paced, action-packed stickman adventure! Stick Archer Run combines endless running with precision archery. Test your reflexes as you sprint forward—all you have to do is aim your bow, time your shots, and take down enemies before they stop you. Simple to play, hard to master. How far can you run?

title: Mahjong 3D Match
description: Welcome to the 3D Mahjong adventure! Challenge your mind with speed and precision. Plan your moves, view the board from all angles and remove pieces intelligently. Beat increasingly difficult levels, play offline and relax with immersive music.

title: Merge Heroes Titans
description:
In this game, you will command squads of melee fighters and ranged archers fighting against waves of enemies. Your agility and strategic thinking will give you an edge to victory.

Unlock new powerful fighters and accurate archers by combining those available for purchase. Place them on the map according to abilities and win.

You will have to discover not only new characters, but also beautiful different worlds, enjoy our new game.

title: Savage Defenders
description: A tower defense strategy action game where you become the last hope of a tribe living at the foot of an ancient volcano. When an asteroid with an alien threat falls to the planet, you must combine magic, tactics and the strength of warriors to stop the invader who is devouring all life.

title: Fashion Valkyries Saga of Style
description: Immerse yourself in the magical world of the North to meet the northern valkyrie warriors and create relevant fashionable images for brave girls. Choose beautiful fur outfits, shining armor, and unusual accessories inspired by northern myths. Experiment with ethnic hairstyles and militant makeup. Try to assemble for each girl the perfect heroic image worthy of the harsh northern warriors!

title: Hyper Wave Challenge
description: Control the Wave, avoid obstacles, collect coins, and reach the end of each level. Every level features dangerous obstacles that require precision and dexterity, while portals keep the gameplay engaging.

title: Transformers Battle For The City
description:
In this game you will find an open world where you will defend the city from the invasion of robots. If you are a fan of transformers, then you will definitely like this game. 
In the game you will find 7 full-fledged story tasks, the complexity of which will gradually increase. After receiving the task, you will go to the place of military operations, where you can use various super-techniques to destroy powerful robot villains.

title: Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor!
description:
Decorate and Makeover your home sweet home with Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor!

Introducing Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor, a home decor game designed exclusively for your aesthetic interior design passions. Dive into the world of decor, where clicking, dragging, and dropping chic furniture transforms empty spaces into captivating living areas.

Your dream home is here. Take away the trash, throw away old and dirty things! Let's have a home makeover with Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor!

title: Kompot's Kitchen
description: Flip the cards, cook up tasty combos and pay the kitchen rent! A cozy roguelike with chef cat Kompot and hundreds of culinary synergies. Free to play!

title: Get Ready With Me: Concert Day
description: Join us in the excitement as you follow the thrilling journey of teen Riri, who is preparing for the concert of a lifetime. From choosing the perfect outfit to applying stunning makeup, you'll get to walk her through all the steps of this beautifying process. But before you start the fun, be sure to help her customize her cowgirl hat, a signature item for the concert she will attend. Then go crazy with the makeup, dress her up in a jaw-dropping outfit, and accessorize for a complete look.

title: Braided Hairstyles Fashion
description: Braided Hairstyles Fashion is a beauty game to be the coolest hairstylist! Meet our two main characters: Regina and Kiki and show your braiding skill.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Words with Prof. Wisely
description:
ind words by connecting letters. Improve your attentiveness, train your brain!

Keep in mind - some crosswords will be difficult to solve.

title: Stumble Guys
description: Stumble Guys is a very hot adventure elimination game. A variety of fun levels await your challenge, and the time has come to test your memory and dexterity! Run, sprint, and slide to overtake your opponents and dodge the obstacles that keep popping up. Can you survive to the end? Invite your friends to join you and kill them all!

title: Mahjong Stack
description: Mahjong Stack is a unique tile-matching game featuring realistic 3D mahjong tiles. Unlike classic match-3, blocks appear in stacked piles. Match identical tiles and drag groups of three to the tray to clear. Use boosters to speed up progress. Dive in and enjoy!

title: Piggy Clicker
description: Piggy Clicker is a classic Clicker game, where you get to have Piggy as your pet and trough clicking buy him toys and such

title: Darling Doll
description: Darling Doll is the ultimate paper doll DIY game that offers a perfect blend of character creation and dress-up game. With a vast collection of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles, you can unleash your creativity and design unique avatars that reflect your personal style. Whether you prefer chibi dolls or glamorous fashion dolls, Darling Doll has got you covered.

title: Tower Stack 2026
description:
​Tap the screen or click the mouse to drop the block. The goal is to stack blocks perfectly and build the highest tower possible. It requires timing and precision.
Stack the blocks as high as you can! Test your precision and timing in this addictive arcade game.

title: Army Defence Dino Shoot
description: Army Defence Dino Shoot is a third-person defense idle game. It seems that a lot of dinosaurs surround you. To protect the base from incoming dinosaurs, you can summon more soldiers and engineers to create a defensive line. Don't forget to upgrade your weapons, damage, and fire rate skills. The longer you hold this position, the more dinosaurs you will meet. Have a good time building a military base.

title: Escape Again
description: Together with the main character of the new online game Escape Again, you will go on a journey through the painted world in search of treasures and adventures. The location in which your hero will be will be visible on the screen in front of you. By controlling his actions you will have to move around the area. Overcoming various obstacles and traps, you will have to help the hero find special magic pins. With their help, he will be able to activate the portal leading to the next level.

title: Acox Runner
description: Acox Runner is a casual game that tests your agility, running, jumping and sliding to avoid obstacles, beautiful music and relaxing but challenging levels make you addicted

title: Draw Climb Race - The Ultimate Hill Climbing Challenge
description: In Draw Climb Race, you draw shapes to climb hills! Any drawing you make will help you climb up steep hills and tricky paths. If you get stuck, just draw a new shape to keep going. Have fun and test your skills in this easy-to-play, addictive game!

title: Count Masters Superhero
description: In Count Masters: Superhero, begin an interesting parkour adventure like no other! As a superhero,you're constantly running, jumping, and avoiding obstacles throughout the level. Such as avoiding rotating mace, cutting machine and so on.

title: Siege Break
description: Siege Break is a portrait fantasy defense game where you deploy heroes to protect a besieged base. Refresh your available hero choices, drag units into open defense slots, and start each wave when you are ready. Hold the path, manage the base HP, and stop every attack before the fortress falls.

title: Halloween Challenge
description: Get ready for a spooky adventure in Halloween Challenge! Bats are flying through the night, carrying candy that you must protect. Your mission? Tap the bats before they escape with the sweet treats. But beware, if even one bat escapes, the game is over! With simple controls and addictive gameplay, Halloween Challenge offers a fun and fast-paced experience for players. Test your reflexes, compete for high scores, and enjoy the eerie Halloween atmosphere. How long can you defend the candy?

title: Rescue Sharp Turn
description: Rescue Puzzle 3D is a lightweight 3D fun puzzle game. You need to click on the correct objects in the small three-dimensional scene to trigger mechanisms, remove obstacles or form a chain reaction to meet the level conditions and rescue the injured character. The levels are short but full of ingenuity: turn off the power switch, move rocks, release water to extinguish fire, synthesize props...

title: Gate Heroes Battle
description: Embark on a journey with your cute monsters and go through positive gates to build up your strength. This will help you defeat stronger enemies. Also watch out for traps and obstacles in your way. Try to reach your strongest form to defeat the final boss.

title: Stickman Rescue Draw 2 Save
description: Your brain is the only shield for the stickman! Enjoy a super casual puzzler in the Stickman Rescue - Draw 2 Save. Use your finger to draw lines and save the stickman from danger! In each level, the stickman is in trouble, such as falling rocks, flying arrows, deep pits, etc. It’s up to you to draw a safe shield, a bridge, or a clever device to keep him safe and complete your rescue mission!

title: MycoThreeMemo
description: Welcome to the quiet hunt, mushroom picker! Embark on an exciting journey through a virtual forest where mushrooms change shape depending on their habitat and the time of the year! In this puzzle game, you have to be careful and have a good memory to find three mushrooms of the same species. Keep in mind that even mushrooms of the same species can look different! Don't forget that there may be a lot of mushrooms in the forest, but your time is always limited. Think fast, but accurately!

title: Bike Stunt Racing Legend
description: Bike Stunt Racing Legend is not merely a motorcycle racing but also a balanced stunt simulation game. Under a 3D game engine, you are required to ride the motorbike to the finish line in the first place. As long as you can keep high speed, the AI opponent will make mistakes and lose you. Don't be afraid of rolling ramps, pass the green arrows to speed up more easily. Keep calm and step on the gas!

title: Paw Clash
description: Paw Clash is an exciting party game where cute animals compete in fun challenges. Enjoy a variety of mini-games that test your skills and reflexes in colorful environments. With simple controls and increasing difficulty, Paw Clash offers endless fun for players of all ages.

title: Uno Online
description:
UNO Online is a strategy card game. In the game, the first player to clear his hand will become the winner. In order to win, you need to guess the deck of cards in your opponent's hands and  arrange your card order reasonably. There are also function cards in the game. When you draw a function card, think about how to turn the situation to your advantage. You can use color cards to
change the color of the game, or use +2 cards to make your opponent's cards never run out.

title: MineTap Merge Clicker
description:
