MineTap is an idle clicker with merge mechanics and crafting. Also there is an adventure, where you can fight zombies and other monsters and even build your own village!

Enjoy mining and treasure hunting. Complete quests and level up your character. Craft your ultimate weapon and slay epic monsters!
Have you ever had a dream to be a hero and save the world? Then tap to play and become a legend of crafting.
Start your epic mining adventure right now - click, tap & rock!

title: Monster Squad Rush
description:
Assemble your squad of powerful monsters, evolve them into champions, and claim victory in the ultimate battle arena. Adventure, strategy, and competition await!

Whether you’re rushing through the course, collecting monsters, or battling for supremacy, Monster Squad Rush offers non-stop action and fun. Build your legacy as the ultimate monster trainer and conquer the arena today!

title: Draw War
description: Unleash your creativity in Draw War. This is a wonderful strategy game. Here drawing meets battles. Build a hero lineup, draw your legions, then unleash the power of your army. The numbers show the soldiers summoned. Click to send Shielded Soldiers, Soldiers on Horseback, or Super Beasts.

title: Cute Craft Lab
description: Step into the colorful world of Cute Craft Lab, a super casual game where creativity shines and every girl can become a true crafting designer. If you love relaxing gameplay mixed with adorable creativity, this cute design adventure is made just for you. In Cute Craft Lab, enter a magical workshop filled with charming tools, sparkling decorations, and endless crafting possibilities.

title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.
Be the hero the world needs!
Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

title: Shelf Sweep
description:
Get ready to tidy up the shelves in Shelf Sweep!
Dive into a fun and addictive sorting puzzle game where your goal is to clean up messy shelves layer by layer. Only the outermost layer of items is visible—clear them by matching three identical items, and reveal the hidden treasures beneath!

title: King Kong Chaos
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in King Kong Chaos, a modern 2D pixel art game where players must navigate through perilous levels, dodging spiked balls and barrels hurled by a colossal gorilla. Along the way, pick up the pickaxe strategically to destroy incoming barrels and secure the coveted golden banana to progress.

title: Aim Ninja
description:
Aim Ninja is a fast-paced skill game that tests your timing and reflexes. 
Stop the moving needle at the perfect moment to score points and improve your accuracy. 
Simple to play but hard to master, Aim Ninja delivers quick, satisfying gameplay sessions 
for players of all ages.

title: Idle Lawnmower
description: In Idle Lawnmower, embrace the tranquility of tending to your virtual lawn, earning gold with each satisfying swath cut. Utilize your earnings to upgrade your lawnmower, enhancing efficiency and earning potential in this idle game of grassy growth and financial gain.

title: Find It Out Colorful Book
description: Begin a challenging yet relaxing casual game in Find It Out Colorful Book. It brings you into a colorful world. You will begin an adventure to find hidden objects. Choose your favorite mode like beach, city, zoo, etc. Each page is filled with color and mysterious numbers waiting to be discovered and unlocked.

title: Brainrot Evolution Game
description: Brainrot Evolution Game is a chaotic meme clicker incremental game where you tap your way through the viral Italian Brainrot universe, unlocking all the brainrot characters and upgrades as you progress! You will get the chance to collect Italian Brainrot characters such as: Bombardino Crocodilo, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, Bombombini Gussini, Cappuccino Assasino, Lirili Larila, Brr Brr Patapim, Burbaloni Luliloli, Bobritto Bandito, Trippi Troppi, Chimpanzini Bananini and more!

title: Happy Blocks
description: Play Happy Blocks free online and jump into a colorful browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Arrange and clear blocks in a satisfying logic puzzle that feels like a smart brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, making it perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for easy, addictive puzzle fun anytime.

title: Arrow Legend
description: Guide the arrows in the right order and clear the board without getting stuck. Arrow Legend is a colorful logic puzzle game where every direction matters. Study the paths, choose the correct arrows, and solve each level with smart moves.

title: Word of Fortune
description:
Guess the hidden 5-letter word, solving the clue and using spins of the letter wheel to get hints! You get 3 spins to reveal letters and 2 guesses to solve it. Win and earn your title, or miss, and you’re out! Each day brings a new puzzle, plus extra themed levels to explore.
This game is great for players of all ages, and it's a fun way to spend time and test vocabulary and mental abilities!

title: Winter Tetrix Trails
description:
Winter Tetrix Trails is a relaxing shape-filling puzzle game set in a snowy world.
Drag and place colorful Tetris-style blocks to complete each unique silhouette — think carefully, fit perfectly, and enjoy the magic of winter puzzles!

title: Extreme Makeover: Harley Edition
description: Extreme Makeover: Harley Edition is a beauty game to help Harley complete a makeover for her new date. Can you give her a fresh new look?
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Cake Merge
description: Cake Merge is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you build whole cakes from colorful slices. Clear the tray, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and unlock new desserts as you play. With smooth animations, cute visuals, and easy-to-learn gameplay, Cake Merge is perfect for fans of casual merge, sorting, and matching games. Earn points, level up, and enjoy the sweetest merges!

title: Crazy Bunnies
description: An exciting platformer about super bunnies in which you have to go through levels created in the style of Minecraft. There is a single and cooperative mode.

title: Slidee
description: In this sliding-puzzle game you will have to make your way by painting the walls. Along the way you'll encounter spikes, portals, and collapsing walls.

title: Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash
description:
Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash:
Explore a world where a geometric wave rushes through crazy obstacles, overcoming challenges one after another. Rhythm, chaos, and a splash of Italian madness — test your reaction and endurance in this geometric trial!

On different levels, you’ll encounter various Italian Brainrot animals: Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, Lirili Larila.

title: Car Dealer Idle
description: Ever dreamed of becoming a top Car Dealer? In Car Dealer Idle, you’ll manage your own vehicle business. Buy and sell cars, expand your showroom, and grow into a real tycoon. Make smart management decisions, upgrade your dealership, and watch your profits skyrocket. Unlock more booths to sell cooler vehicles. Unlock repair areas, test drive areas, etc.

title: Ball Dunk Fall
description: In Ball Dunk Fall, your challenge is to guide a constantly falling ball through hoops of varying difficulties by tapping the screen. Test your precision and reflexes as you navigate through tricky obstacles. With each successful dunk, experience the thrill of victory and aim for high scores!

title: Road To 7
description:
Welcome to Road To 7, a fun casual math puzzle for everyone.
Start merging numbers from the starting point along the given path. Calculate adjacent digits with addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. All results must be non-negative integers between 0 and 9.
Finish merging all numbers and get 7 as the final result to clear levels. Sharpen your math and logical thinking in relaxing puzzle gameplay.

title: SeaDragons.io
description: SeaDragons.io is an epic combination of Slither.io and sea monsters. You control a sea dragon that needs to grow bigger and dominate the entire sea.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Disassemble the picture: Puzzle!
description:
Unlock your brain power and dive into the world of puzzles!
Start playing "Disassemble the picture: Puzzle!" right now!

In this fun and addictive game, your goal is to move the blocks to clear the screen and reveal the hidden image.
But here’s the twist — the blocks can only move in specific directions, so you’ll need to think carefully and plan your moves strategically.

title: Parking Frenzy
description: Welcome to Parking Frenzy, the ultimate test of precision, planning, and timing! Forget everything you know about driving simulators—this game doesn’t need pedals, steering wheels, or complicated controls. Just swipe your finger, draw the perfect path, and let your car glide into the parking spot. With a stylish 3D look, dynamic environments, and intuitive gameplay, Parking Frenzy delivers a uniquely satisfying experience that’s easy to play and hard to master.

title: Money Factory: Tycoon Idle Game
description: Money Factory is a fast-paced clicker game with strategic elements where you build and expand your financial empire by optimizing money production lines. Start with a simple setup and gradually grow by upgrading equipment, unlocking new production areas, and enhancing efficiency to skyrocket your profits.

title: Chibi Doll - Avatar Creator
description:
Street - it's no matter build your modern city life or just stick with village-like town world you always be enjoy with it! 

Room - decorate and design home girly world.

Gacha - unlock countless gachapon surprises your lovely avatar, bring gacha to your fantasy life! 

Dress Up Games - match and mix more than 5000+ girly items for dressing up princess: hairstyle, clothes, hats, accessories, freckles, moles, blush, wings, tails.

title: Parking Fury 3D: Night City
description:
Welcome to the adrenaline-filled world of Parking Fury 3D, where you'll be at the wheel of various vehicles navigating the bustling streets of a massive city.

Whether you're behind the wheel of a taxi or driving an ambulance through traffic to save lives, each mission presents its own challenges and rewards.

For those who dare, there is the exciting world of car theft missions. Take on the role of a skilled driver tasked with procuring specific vehicles under the cover of darkness.

title: Purrfect Puzzle
description: Purrfect Puzzle is an adorable cat-themed tile-merging puzzle game where players strategically place and combine cat tiles with different values to achieve higher scores. With relaxing pastel visuals, the game challenges players to think ahead while enjoying a cozy, heartwarming experience. Perfect for puzzle lovers and cat enthusiasts alike!

title: Blocks Breaker
description:
Shoot Blocks break Blocks, upgrade your the tiny car to make it shoot faster to break more blocks!!!


Get coins with every block you break!

title: Sort Parking
description: Sort cars by type. You cannot park in a full parking lot. Cars cannot be placed in front of different types. You can increase the number of car models with coins available in the game. If you clear many stages, you will get pieces for the background. When pieces of the same type are matched, the background is completed and the background can be changed.

title: Super Rock Climber
description:
Overcome treacherous obstacles and dizzying landscapes as you control a tenacious climber in this thrilling third-person adventure. Inspired by cult classics such as Overcome This and the challenging climbing game.

Ragdoll Rock Climber is not for the faint of heart - it's for those who crave the thrill of conquering the seemingly impossible. Prove that you are the best climber by posting the best time and overcoming the toughest challenges.

title: Mini Games Relax Collection 2
description: Relax and take a mini-game tour! Mini Games: Relax Collection 2 brings you a series of casual and fun mini-games, designed for you to relax in your spare time! There are various types of games,each easy to play and extremely fun, allowing you to immerse yourself easily in the game world.

title: Fruit Jam
description:
Make juice from fresh fruits in this easy and enjoyable Match-3 puzzle game!
Click on the fruit, if the fruit and the cup are the same color, just squeeze it.

title: Seek & Find
description: Dive into a fun puzzle hidden object game with intrigue and excitement in "Seek & Find-Hidden Object Game," where keen eyes and quick wits reign supreme. This scavenger hunt game invites players of all ages to find hidden objects through beautifully crafted scenes, exploring maps and secrets skillfully concealed within. With a blend of charm and challenge, this fun hidden object game is designed to captivate, entertain, and test your observational skills like never before!

title: Two Carts - Downhill
description: Two Carts - Downhill is a fast-paced arcade game where you control two carts simultaneously, each on its own obstacle-filled road. Use the left and right arrow keys to steer each cart independently, collecting components to score points. Pick up power-ups like Ice to slow down the game or Shield to protect against obstacles. As you progress, the game speeds up, challenging your reflexes and multitasking skills. How long can you keep both carts on track?

title: Hexa Sort Trick or Treat
description: Step into a haunted puzzle realm where glowing hexagonal blocks hide within a web of spooky challenges. Your task: sort eerie, color-coded pieces into their rightful places before the shadows close in. With every drag and drop, you’ll sharpen your wits and unravel chillingly clever layouts that grow trickier as you progress. Easy to pick up yet devilishly addictive, this Halloween brain-teaser will keep players of all ages spellbound through hundreds of spooky levels.

title: Emoji Drop Themes
description: Dive into the addictive fun of Emoji Drop, a delightful physics puzzle game where strategy meets chain reactions! Drop a variety of charming items, from classic emojis and juicy fruits to wild animals into the container. The magic happens when two matching items touch, merging into something new and bigger. With a challenging Adventure Mode and a relaxing Classic Mode, can you master the merge and discover the final, ultimate item?

title: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy
description: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is a fast-paced action game where you take out your frustration on a relentless, annoying dummy. With quick reflexes and nonstop punches, you’ll unleash a flurry of blows in simple, satisfying bursts. Stay sharp, keep hitting, and enjoy every moment of chaotic stress relief wrapped in hilarious impact.

title: Moto Attack Bike Racing
description: Moto Attack - Bike Racing is a fun bike racing simulator that takes speed and action to the next level. Drive your motorcycle and race against opponents. You can use weapons to attack them. Ride your bike through challenging tracks, and avoid obstacles like people crossing the street, cabs, boxes, etc.

title: Autumn Glam Gala
description: Get ready to light up the season with Autumn Glam Gala, a beauty makeup game, the ultimate fashion and makeup experience! Transform three besties into autumn-style icons for the gala of the year.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: WormsArena.io
description: A great Snake IO game is beginning with the Worms Arena IO game! The baits are all around the map and collect them to make your snake the largest of the arena. Make strategic moves and trap your opponents to make them fail. Try to achieve the highest score and wear the crown. Unlock new snakes at the marketplace with coins. Let the super snake adventure begin!

title: Fashion World Simulator
description: It's time for some super cool styles! Be a fabulous fashionista stylist and dress up a supermodel to rule all the fashion runways around the world! Get ready to dive into the ultimate dress-up experience and show your creativity. This game is all about makeovers, dress-ups, and decorating new cool stuff. Compete and vote for your style to win the competition. Join us and start your fashion journey!

title: Garage Master - Nuts and Bolts
description:
Your goal as a Garage Master is to sort out nuts by color to corresponding bolt. Sounds easy, doesn't it? Think twice! The color sort game presents a challenges by mixing all the nuts and making it difficult to find the corresponding bolt.
It’s a perfect time to train your problem-solving abilities in this color sort game.
The best part is when your car is finished, open my super garage and customize it by choosing one of 4 skins.

title: Easter Style Junction Egg Hunt Extravaganza
description: Immerse yourself in the charm of Easter Valley in "Easter Style Junction: Egg Hunt Extravaganza"! Join four lively bunnies in a grand Easter celebration featuring a Bunny Dressup Competition and Egg Catch Challenge amidst picturesque landscapes and vibrant meadows.

title: Devs Simulator
description: Welcome to the world of high technology and business! In this exciting strategy game you will become the director of a thriving IT company. Your task is to find the best programmers, assemble a dream team and lead it to success!

title: We Are In A Simulation Simulator
description: We Are In A Simulation Simulator challenges you to question nothing and mimic everything. Blend in by copying the actions of others to survive in a strange digital world where free will doesn’t exist. Stay alert, follow the crowd, and don’t get caught acting out of sync. Play for free online on mobile or desktop and test your ability to conform in this mysterious simulation!

title: Jewel Legend Quest
description: The most legendary quest of your life begins! Miners from all around the world have come to get their hands on these precious gems. Join them in the effort and engage in various challenges while trying to dig out as many diamonds as possible.

title: Park Fever
description: Can you clear the traffic jam? Move vehicles in the right order, free the buses, and pick up waiting passengers. Match colors, plan every move, and enjoy a fun puzzle that combines parking strategy with passenger management!

title: Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic
description:
Rediscover the captivating world of Solitaire Klondike!

This timeless card game not only entertains but also enhances logical thinking, offering hours of engaging pastime. Play your favorite solitaire anytime, anywhere.

Join the community of enthusiasts and prove your mastery in Klondike!

Keep an eye on the leaderboard and become the top player among all!

title: Cake Link Master
description: Cake Link Master is a fun puzzle game where you tap two matching cakes to connect them with a line. The line can turn up to two times but cannot go over other tiles. The game has 120 challenging levels, and the difficulty grows as you play. Clear the cakes, solve the puzzles, and enjoy hours of sweet, relaxing fun!

title: Serious Head 2
description:
The adventures of a serious head continue.
Portals open, monsters come out.
Prepare for battle: rebuild your base and upgrade your weapons.
Take your partners to help you and put up a decent resistance!

title: Happy Monsters 2
description:
A bundle of fun games designed for children of all ages that will delight everyone!

Our little monsters love to play all sorts of games where you collect coins. Help them gather as many as possible to unlock all the toys. Complete the entire toy collection!

title: Color 3D - Bump It Up
description:
The main principle is pretty simple – you are controlling a small ball that is always moving forward.

On your way, there are a few obstacles that you need to get through. There’s a small problem however, because you can only touch obstacles that are the same color as your ball. If you touch an obstacle with a different color, the game ends and you need to start from the beginning.

title: Planet Hopper
description: Use your ship to navigate and jump between different planets across the galaxy, but be careful not to drift off into the vastness of outer space!

title: CS: Chaos Squad
description: CS: Chaos Squad is an exciting 5v5 team-based shooter that demands tactical thinking, teamwork, and quick reflexes. Engage in fast-paced battles where you can purchase weapons and gear each round, allowing you to adapt your strategy on the fly. The ranking system tracks player and team performance, encouraging continuous improvement and competition. Fight for victory, build team synergy, and prove that your squad is the best on the battlefield!

title: Cinema Business - Idle Games
description:
Build and manage your own cinema empire! 
Unlock movie rooms, snack and burger corners to attract more customers.
Hire staff, upgrade facilities, and keep your theater running smoothly.
Earn cash even while you’re offline and grow your business.
Become the ultimate cinema tycoon in this fun idle arcade game!

title: TOP HOG
description: Welcome to the forest adventure! A drowsy bear just wants to rest, but a playful group of hedgehogs  has decided to throw a party close by. Your task? Grab a hockey stick and send those troublemakers soaring through the air! Build your strength, collect bonuses to enhance your skills, and face the exciting challenges in each level. Who will rise as the winter forest champion? Become a true bear hockey expert! Simple to play, fun, and packed with thrilling airborne action! Give it a try now!

title: Stickman Archer: Shooting Arrows at Reds
description:
Red hooligans have started to take over ancient excavations!

Only the Great Archer can stop the villains in red!

Stickman the Archer wants to save the world from evil hooligans and now he needs your help!
Your goal is to destroy enemy shooters and defeat all the bosses. You are armed with a bow and arrows!

title: Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition
description: Relive 2024’s hottest fashion trends in Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition! From TikTok-inspired makeup to glamorous red carpet looks, this game brings together the best dress-up challenges of the year! Style iconic outfits, create bold beauty looks, and transform your favorite characters for every occasion—festivals, dates, holidays, and more! Are you ready to be the ultimate fashion trendsetter? Play now and own the style game!

title: Fruit Survivor
description: Fruit Survivor is a cool and exciting 3D cartoon survival arcade game. You play as a gardener who is attacked by fruit monsters. You have to fight your way out and destroy them with different weapons. I recommend choosing the blender and maxing it out first. It can deal with many strong enemies effectively. You can also experiment with different weapon combinations to challenge yourself with harder levels. Enjoy hunting fruit monsters!

title: Zumbia Quest
description: Explore a vibrant world with never-ending puzzles and diverse environments in each chapter. Push your limits with exciting timed challenges with special types of marbles to help you along the way. Unlock new marble shooters as you advance through exciting levels.

title: Ellie's Recipe: Dubai Chocolate Bar
description: Ellie’s Recipe: Dubai Chocolate Bar is a stylish cooking game where you help Ellie craft luxurious chocolate creations with a touch of Dubai elegance. Mix ingredients, mold gourmet fillings, and design decadent treats step by step.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Farm Block
description: Farm Block is an engaging farm-themed puzzle game where players slide adorable animal blocks to free them from the farm. Test your strategic thinking and enjoy the charming countryside setting! With its mix of puzzle-solving and elimination mechanics, Farm Block offers a fun and rewarding challenge for all ages.

title: Marble Blast
description: Ready to match, blast, and conquer? This vibrant marble shooter game offers endless fun and challenges that test your skills and strategy. Clear colorful marbles, unlock powerful boosters, and prove you’re the master of marble puzzles! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, this game delivers excitement like no other.

title: Donut Run
description: This thrilling arcade game is designed for adventure enthusiasts and fans of active gameplay. Step into the role of a fearless rolling character, racing through dynamic levels filled with vibrant settings and exhilarating obstacles. With easy-to-master controls, you’ll quickly dive into the action, experiencing a blend of tension and adrenaline. Each level features diverse obstacles and traps, ensuring every run feels fresh and exciting.

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!

title: Cat vs Kripotians
description:
In the game, we have to help Kitty save his people from the terrible Kripotians.       
In this difficult task, we will have an unexpected green ally!       
Beautiful levels, interesting dialogues and of course a lot of enemies and a lot of shooting! ! The game has both difficult and simple missions and even timed missions! All this together creates an atmosphere of a game that does not let go until the very end!

title: Dark Academia Wedding
description: Step into a world of moody elegance in Dark Academia Wedding! Help the bride and groom prepare for their enchanting, gothic-inspired celebration. Choose vintage dresses, romantic accessories, and rich color palettes that capture the essence of dark academia. From candlelit ceremonies to mysterious venues, every detail matters. Create the perfect blend of classic romance and intellectual charm in this stylish wedding dress up game!

title: Stunt Bike Rider Bros
description: Stunt Bike Rider Bros is a motorcycle racing and show game that you can play in both 1 player and 2 player mode with your friend. There are 3 different game modes in the game. In the "Racing Mode", you can compete with both your friend and other motorcycle drivers. In the "Career Mode", try to complete the difficult stages in a limited time. In the "Open World", you can earn coins and diamonds by performing various stunts with your motorcycles.

title: Cityquest
description: Guess the hidden city by using compass directions and unlocking helpful hints like continent, flag, time zone, and name clues.

title: Grandma's Last Stand
description:
Granny is in a hurry to get home and bake some pies. But there's one problem - first she needs to bake a few hundred zombies! They'll be chasing you in cars and motorcycles, they'll have machine guns, rocket launchers, and support drones. But you've got a pretty good arsenal too - from a revolver and machine guns to a minigun and a bazooka. Help Granny get home, roast them all!

INSTRUCTIONS

title: Little Alchemy
description: Little Alchemy is a fun and educational open-ended discovery game where you mix basic elements like air, earth, fire, and water to craft new and increasingly complex items.Created by Jakub Koziol of Recloak Games as a Chrome browser hobby project, Little Alchemy launched on December 8, 2010, and its success eventually led to the release of a sequel indie game, Little Alchemy 2, seven years later.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Poppy Strike 5
description: Poppy Strike 5 is a first person shooter game with elements of horror where your mission is to use big arsenal of weapons to shoot huggy wuggy and kisiy misiy and find a way to escape liminal spaces of haunted toy factory.

title: Defenders of the Realm: An Epic War
description: Defenders of the Realm: An Epic War is a tower defense game to not let your enemies surpass your base. Try to put your troop, which has different skills, in the right place to win the war.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Glam Guru Puzzle Collection
description: Glam Guru Puzzle Collection is packed with exciting mini-games that test your style sense, observation skills, and matching abilities. If you enjoy creative fashion adventures and clever puzzles, this amazing casual Collection is waiting for you!

title: Gladiators. Merge and Fight
description: Gladiators: Merge and Fight is an engaging arcade game that combines character attribute creation and enhancement with combat. In this game, you start with basic materials and improve your gladiator's attributes by upgrading weapon, shield, armor, and helmet materials. Every decision affects your hero's stats. After preparing your gladiator, press the "Start" button to begin the second part of the game: arena battles.

title: Elite Chess
description: Enjoy classic gameplay with three chess modes, each offering varying time settings suited to your play style. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond, and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Color Strings
description: Looking for a simple way to exercise your brain every day? Try Color Strings! This game features straightforward rules and fun, challenging gameplay. In this puzzle game, you need to rearrange the strings on the dots to match the given pattern. With various puzzle levels, you'll keep your brain sharp in just a few minutes each day.

title: Mahjong Tile Club
description: Step into the relaxing world of Mahjong Tile Club, where timeless tile-matching meets innovative gameplay! This solitaire-style mahjong game is perfect for anyone looking for a calm yet engaging puzzle experience. With simple rules and soothing gameplay, it’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. Match identical tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

title: Dinosaur Cards
description: Explore, match, conquer! Dino challenge! Win by matching sets of dinosaurs faster than time runs out. Dive into dino fun today!

title: Tower of Hell: Obby Blox
description: Tower of Hell skill game, classic mode from your favorite game right in the browser on your computer and phone!

title: Hazel Tangle Rope 3D: Sorting Puzzle
description: Untangle colorful twisted ropes in this satisfying 3D brain-teaser puzzle game. Strategically select and move rope endpoints to separate tangled knots and sort them by color. Use logical thinking and spatial reasoning to solve increasingly complex rope puzzles and become a tangle master.

title: Fun Town Parking
description: Funtown Parking is an exciting parking simulation game where you must follow paths and park in designated spots while avoiding obstacles and challenges. As the levels progress, the routes become more complex, testing your precision and driving skills. Can you navigate through the chaos and park without a scratch? Take on the challenge and master every level!

title: The White Room 4
description: The White Room 4 is an immersive escape game that challenges your logic and problem-solving skills. Find yourself trapped in a hotel room and embark on a thrilling adventure to escape. Utilize the tools at your disposal, solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and crack passwords to unlock your path to freedom. Will you be able to conquer the puzzles and break free from this challenging escape experience?

title: Tap Car
description:
Unveil stunning car masterpieces by solving image puzzles. Every tap reveals more of the picture—can you uncover them all? A must-play for car enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike!

Would you like a few more variations depending on the tone you're aiming for (like more casual, exciting, or elegant)?

title: Pixel Fun Color By Number
description: Pixel Fun - Color By Number is a fun coloring game that lets you bring pixel art to life. With casual number-based instructions, you’ll fill in each pixel square to reveal stunning artwork.Each image is divided into tiny pixels. Each is assigned a number that corresponds to a color. For example, click on the city scene to fill in color and light up the street.

title: Squarehead Hero
description:
Squarehead Hero is a fun, turn-based puzzle game where you help a brave, square-headed hero explore dangerous dungeons full of monsters and treasure.
Plan your moves carefully on a grid board — fight enemies, grab loot, and gear up for the next challenge.
Think you’ve got what it takes to lead Squarehead to victory? Jump in and find out!

title: Ultimate Brainrot Clicker
description:
Tap into chaos. Click your way to the final meme singularity.

Ultimate Brainrot Clicker is a chaotic, high-speed clicker-incremental game set in a futuristic memeverse where AI-generated absurdity and Italian brainrot collide. Your mission? Click endlessly to generate Neural Coins, unlock absurd characters, and witness the full meltdown of meme logic.

title: Submarine Attack
description: Command a submarine, destroy enemy ships with torpedoes, unlock new weapons, and conquer the ocean. Engage in thrilling naval battles, use unique abilities, face numerous enemies, and wield powerful armaments to achieve victory.

title: Color Dodge
description:
Color Dodge is a fast-paced, addictive color-matching arcade game where reflexes and precision are your only hope!

Control a glowing circle and survive as colorful walls charge toward you from all directions. Here's the twist — you must collide only with the wall segment that matches your color, or you explode in a juicy blast!

Whether you're chasing high scores or just vibing with neon chaos, Color Dodge delivers bite-sized action with a splash of style.

title: Sokoban P/R
description: Help the adorable loader handle his daily tasks in the classic Sokoban puzzle! Enjoy simple design, clever challenges, and the ability to develop your own strategy. Levels will gradually expand, so you can always test your skills. The best puzzle solutions await you!

title: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to Farm Animal Sort Puzzle, a fun and relaxing casual puzzle game set on a lively farm. Your mission is simple but addictive: match the appropriate animal or vegetable to the customer's needs. Sort adorable farm animals into the correct spaces and enjoy the satisfying challenge of smart organization.

title: COINs
description: A line of 10 coins with the same number changes to a coin with one higher number. Coins can be moved anywhere, even to empty lines or on coins with different numbers. You can add coins at any time. The game is cleared if you make a coin with the number 10! The faster the clear time, the higher the score.

title: Neon Gravity
description:
Defy gravity in this intense neon-soaked arcade runner! In Neon Gravity, your goal is to survive as long as possible by switching gravity to avoid deadly spikes, saws, and mines.

Master the timing to pass safely between rotating gears and trigger the "Perfect" bonus for massive points. As your score increases, the game speeds up, testing your reflexes to the limit. Can you unlock all 10 unique skins, including the Ninja and the Eye?

title: Driver Master Simulator
description: Driver Master Simulator is a 3D vehicle driving game. In Truck Mode, your task is to swiftly transport animals to their destinations. All transport missions have tight time constraints. Once you’ve earned $20,000, unlock Bus Mode and take the wheel of a bus. Reach $30,000, and Chopper Mode lets you pilot a helicopter. Feeling cash-strapped? Watch ads to claim $10,000 each time!

title: Coin Blitz
description: Fast-paced coin shooting action! Destroy waves of enemies, collect tons of coins, and grow stronger as you play. Drag and position your shooter strategically while watching satisfying coin explosions and smooth gameplay. Simple to start, hard to master — how long can you survive?

title: Smash Defense
description: Smash Defense is a chaotic baseball-inspired action game where your swings decide the fate of entire worlds. Crush waves of flying monsters using your bat and evolve your ball with fiery, electric, and explosive powers. Travel through dynamic environments like deep oceans and erupting volcanoes, upgrade your skills, and prove you’re the ultimate monster-slaying champion.

title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
description:
In this physics-based innovative puzzle game, your objective is to strategically place screws and nuts to fall all the wooden blocks.
Unleash your cognitive ability as you tackle each brain-teasing level, each one designed to test your problem-solving skills. From simple puzzles to complex constructions, this 2D puzzle game offers an array of challenges suitable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.

title: Cat Evolution 2
description:
Tap. Evolve. Dominate the Cat Kingdom!

The cats are back, and this time, they're taking over with the power of your fingertips! In Cat Evolution 2,  evolution goes clicker-style.
Tap your way through generations of quirky cats, unlock bizarre and adorable mutations, evolve to the max.

Get your paws ready and your fingers tapping. Cat Evolution 2 is the ultimate idle cat clicker you didn’t know you needed!

title: Eat Blobs Simulator
description: The battle of the blobs and slimes is beginning in this great eating simulator. Pick your slime character and start competing against others. Eat smaller blobs and slimes, and make yours bigger than the others. Become the king of the blob arena! Buy various blob skins during the game. On each game, receive various rewards with the blob sizes and coins. Chase smaller blobs and eat them. Collect blobs around and increase your score.

title: Dirty Them All
description: Let's splash some dirt over the walking people near the road with this Dirty Them All game! Drive your car through the mud and splash it all around the other people. Let them chase you until the finish line. The more people chase, the more scores you get. Let this funny and entertaining adventure begin!

title: Word Search with hints
description: Search for hidden words on the letter grid. Use hints to solve words and improve your skills. This game is great for players of all ages, and it's a fun way to spend time and test mental abilities!

title: Cat Cut
description: A fun game about a hungry cat, get him a fish, cut the rope so that it falls directly to the cat. All objects move according to physics, do not miss the fish, do not upset the cat!

title: Brawl Stars Battle
description: Brawl Stars Battle is an exciting action shooting game where you control powerful heroes armed with guns and special abilities to defeat opponents in fast-paced combat! Select 3v3 battle mode and fight alongside your teammates. The team that kills fifteen opponents first wins. Use guns and powerful abilities in intense battles.

title: Bolts - Unscrew It
description:
Unscrew the bolts and move them into available empty holes to release the wooden boards. Keep in mind that the number of free spaces is limited. A wrong move can block an important screw or leave a board trapped, so plan every action carefully.

The puzzles become more challenging as you progress. New shapes, obstacles, and increasingly complicated constructions will put your problem-solving skills to the test. Experiment with different strategies and use helpful boosters whenever you get stuck.

title: Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake
description: Whip up layers of color and sweetness in Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake! Mix, bake, and frost your way to the perfect rainbow treat, then finish with cute decorations that make your cake sparkle with charm.

title: Color Sort Mania
description: Forget about everyday life and indulge in a simple world where sorting is an art. Put the bubbles in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Pet Fall
description: You can move animals from side to side. You have to collect full horizontal lines to make them disappear. Some animals are frozen and must be released twice, some are locked in cages and cannot be moved. Use bonuses when necessary

title: Kings and Queens Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Kings and Queens Solitaire TriPeaks is a casual puzzle solitaire game whose objective is to stack all cards on the game table in sequence. This game is ideal for card players, especially solitaire fans, as it is intuitive to pick up quickly with similar solitaire gameplay but with a slight twist—cards are not in laid out the same way, suits don't matter and rank order can go from high to low to high again!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Baby Penguin Fishing
description: Tiny Fishing is a fun and addictive 2D puzzle fishing simulation game that challenges your skills. Enjoy this charming game as you explore a fishing adventure. The game has two modes: Fishing and Trawling. In Fishing mode, you cast your line by clicking on each fish’s body and catch them quickly to advance to the next level. In Trawling mode, you release the net by clicking on the desired area and capture everything within it. You also have to complete the objective fast.

title: Italian Brainrot Bike Rush
description: Hop on for chaotic fun in Italian Brainrot Bike Rush, a meme-filled obby bike platformer. Pick from 5 absurd meme legends and ride through floating platforms, deadly traps, and wild jumps. Play 5 levels across 3 modes—Normal, Challenge, and One Life. Collect coins, unlock checkpoints, and conquer brainrot chaos. Perfect for fans of meme-based bike racing and Italian brainrot platformers!

title: Princesses at Horror School
description: In this game you will meet two charming monster girls who study at a school for young monsters. Every morning, the girls carefully think over their images, mixing elements of a classic princess and a creepy monster. Girls have different fashion preferences, but they have one thing in common - these two unusual girlfriends always attract the admiring glances of classmates. After all, they are not just princesses, but real monsters whose terrifying style makes even the bravest tremble!

title: Limited Defense
description:
Limited Defense is a strategic tower defense game where you command bandits, archers, and explosive towers to hold back relentless waves of enemies. Face off against mischievous Green Slimes, fearsome Orcs, and towering bosses like the Boss King Slime. Upgrade your defenses, unlock legendary warriors, and test your tactical skills in intense, fast-paced battles!
Can you make it in this tower defense game?

title: Drift.io
description: Drift.io is a fast-paced multiplayer car battle and racing game. Fight other players with rockets, freezing laser beams, and bouncy explosives in Battle game mode, or race others in exciting matches while dodging deadly items in Grand Prix game mode.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Rope Rescue! - Unique Puzzle
description: Rope Rescue is a puzzle game with simple controls but a challenging twist. Strategize to save everyone using ropes while dodging tricky traps and obstacles. Stay sharp to overcome each level and claim exciting rewards. With its easy-to-learn mechanics and increasingly complex challenges, this game will keep you hooked as you perfect your rescue skills!

title: Zombie Rodeo Multiplication
description: Don't let your zombie lose his head or other body parts in this Halloween themed multiplication math game. Answer the multiplication problem correctly before time runs out so your zombie doesn't lose a body part. If you answer incorrectly or time runs out before you get the correct answer, a body part falls off of your zombie. Once all of his body parts fall off, the game is over.  See how far you can go and earn coins to get upgrades.  Four difficulty settings to choose from.

title: Goo Slime Jump
description: Goo Slime Jump is a fun and relaxing casual game, tap to make the slime jump and make sure it reaches the finish line, the relaxing music and calm gameplay make you addicted.

title: Starry Style Dorama of Dream
description: Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of Korean doramas heroes! Here you can become a stylist for two aspiring young film actors: a young actress whose heart beats to the rhythm of romantic stories, and a charismatic actor whose smile can melt even the coldest hearts. You will be able to choose from a variety of outfits, accessories and hairstyles, creating unique images that emphasize the individuality of your characters.

title: Organizer master
description: An engaging 3D puzzle with numerous levels. Find pairs and arrange objects so that everything fits. Develop spatial thinking and solve challenges. Enjoy high-quality 3D graphics in this captivating browser puzzle game.

title: TB Avataria Life Girl
description:
Hey, how about helping me decorate my house? You need to decorate my home beautifully, buy me nice clothes, and feed me. Let's get started — right now, I have an empty house, and we need to furnish it together. Let's make it look organized and cozy! Before I get too hungry, you must take me to the café to eat, or I might lose my life from hunger!
We also need to earn money. To make money, reach the computer and use the money-making app. You can either buy things or continue earning more money!

title: Puzzle Wood Block
description:
Put the given blocks of pattern in 9x9 squares to fill them.
Once the 9x9 slots are all Filled up, the blocks in it will be cleared!
Achieve high score by clearing many combos at once!

title: Earthquake io
description: Earthquake io is a realistic 3D physics-based disaster simulator in which you take control of the forces of the Earth to destroy cities, destroy buildings and crush all small objects to compete with other players in a fierce battle.

title: Bus Driver Simulator 3D
description:
Bus Driver Simulator 3D is a bus simulator in which you will be able to drive different types of buses traveling around different parts of the world including Los Angeles, Berlin, Rome, Alaska and so on.

Each scenario in Bus Driver Simulator 3D has special characteristics. So, for example, in Alaska you will be driving on snowy tundra, and other cars will not be very much, but on the city highway in Los Angeles the traffic will be more intense.

title: Family Tree Emoji
description:
Is a logic game that combines the excitement of deciphering with the surprise of bizarre combinations.

The game will come across family trees with missing cells, you need to choose the emoji that fits into that gap.

Look at the parents and children to find commonalities and complete all levels.

title: Ball Tower of Hell
description: Ball in hell rolling his way to the top of the tower. There are many difficulties on the way, but the brave ball not scared

title: My Little City
description: My Little City is the latest Match-3 challenge for aspiring city planners! The City Council has commissioned your company to prepare countless new building plots for construction. They need you to ensure the construction projects go according to plan! Supply building materials such as stones, water, electricity, and more! Use various boosters like sledgehammers, dynamite, or paint bombs to complete tasks on time. Play My Little City for free now and build your own Little City!

title: SPRUNKI 3D Escape
description: Sprunki Phase 10 lets players experiment with various musical elements represented by characters, each producing sounds like beats, melodies, or effects. Players create original compositions or follow sequences by combining these elements to unlock special musical bonuses. This edition in the Sprunki series adds new layers, making it a refreshing iteration for fans of the music-mixing genre.

title: Save The Beauty
description: Save The Beauty is a free online adventure game for kids, which with rich levels, 2D perspective, fresh style, cartoon skin, and a random combination of level challenges that will surely open your eyes. Different levels have different traps, do not let the little sister hurt, or you will have to start all over again. Interested friends come to experience it!

title: Basketball Fever
description:
Get ready for endless basketball fun! Basketball Fever features four exciting basketball challenges anyone can enjoy. 

Sharpen your aim, beat your high score, or just enjoy quick bursts of arcade-style fun, Basketball Fever delivers nonstop action that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. It’s the ultimate way to test your reflexes, timing, and accuracy.

Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying physics make every shot feel rewarding.

title: Countryside Truck Drive
description: Embark on a picturesque journey in Countryside Truck Driving, where you'll navigate your transport truck through a charming countryside town, with stunning ice-capped mountain ranges as your backdrop; collect coins, dodge roadblocks, and test your skills to achieve the highest score.

title: Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles
description:
Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles is a relaxing jigsaw-style puzzle game where you assemble beautiful images piece by piece. Enjoy a calming experience as each picture comes to life under your fingertips!
Who It's For
Ideal for puzzle lovers, casual players, and anyone who enjoys peaceful, visually pleasing gameplay.
Start assembling now with Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles — discover a cozy world of delightful puzzles!

title: Build and Run
description: Experience the ultimate blend of running and building in our action-packed game! Navigate through exciting levels by constructing missing parts of the level while running at full speed. Master using horizontal builds, slopes, and ramps to keep moving forward and avoid dangerous traps.

title: Squirrel with a gun!
description: "- Ah, what a headache.... Where did the evil nut-headed bipeds come from...? What's that ?...? ? AAAAAA!"  This game is about a checkered squirrel who shoots cool weapons and parkour through levels in slo mo. Help the squirrel defeat the evil nutheads and take away their nuts. ??  Complete the challenges and get cool prizes! ?

title: Russian Fishing at Sea
Bubble Rush
description: You are surrounded by colorful bubbles. You need to shoot bubbles in such a way as to form a group of three or more bubbles of the same color. When you use up all your available shots, a row of bubbles will approach you from above, below, or from the sides. When you completely clear one side, bubbles from that side will no longer appear

title: Battle Arena
description: Battle Arena is a thrilling RPG adventure battle game that seamlessly blends heart-pounding action with strategic gameplay. Create your team from over 50 unique heroes, each inspired by iconic characters you know and love.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Emoji Frenzy
description:
Test your reflexes and knowledge in this fast-paced emoji matching game! 
Tap the correct emoji before time runs out, build streaks, and unlock new themes. Simple to play, hard to master!

title: Party Animals Cats Evolution
description:
**Gameplay:** Creating a cat has never been easier!  Just click on identical kittens, connect them together and get new types!  Go through all the stages of cats evolution and populate the planet with Party Animals!
Cats themselves generate coins - use them to buy additional cats, or boosters to improve the game!

**Content:** Discover 21 unique and cute party animals, each with a name as distinctive as their personality and a wonderful description that brings out their individual charm.

title: Hill Station Bus Simulator
description: "Hill Station Bus Simulator" invites players to step into the shoes of a skilled bus driver navigating the challenging terrains of picturesque hill stations. As the primary protagonist, your mission is to efficiently transport passengers through winding roads, steep ascents, and captivating landscapes, while managing a thriving bus service. The game offers an engaging blend of realistic driving simulation, strategic decision-making, and immersive experiences.

title: Sweet Merge
description: Dive into 'Sweet Merge', a relaxing and delightful game where your goal is simple: merge and combine an assortment of sweets like jellies, cakes, and candies to create a new bigger sweet. How large can you make your sweet merge?

title: Rift of Hell-Demons War
description:
Hordes of insidious demons are lurking in the hellish catacombs! Can you challenge hundreds of hellish creatures and destroy them all as you descend closer to the citadel?
You have several types of weapons at your disposal and an almost endless supply of ammo along the way!
With each step, collecting gold that falls from enemies, you will become stronger and stronger, strength, speed of movement, arsenal of deadly weapons, armor - all this will depend on your actions.

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: Flight Pilot Airplane Games 24
description: In this Real Flight Pilot Airplane Games 24 you will experience the piloting of an aircraft. This free airplane game will let you involve in navigating the aircraft through a series of obstacles, such as sea, mountains, buildings, and other aircraft while avoiding crashes and collisions and maintaining the plane's height and speed. It would be best if you also had to manage the airplane fuel, speed, altitude, and other flying physics.

title: Archer: Dungeon Hero
description: A fast-paced fantasy roguelike where an archer battles waves of monsters, unlocks abilities, and creates a unique build during every run.

title: Supermarket Sort: Grocery Game
description: Sharpen your sorting skills, challenge your brain, and race against the clock in each level. With increasingly tricky puzzles and tons of grocery items to sort, the fun never stops!

title: Cards: Klondike Solitaire
description:
A classic card game known for its simple and fun mechanics. If you love solitaire games, then this game is just for you! A famous card puzzle game that is popular among players all over the world.
Perfectly relaxing!

title: ASMR Washing & Fixing
description: This game is one of the cleaning games that gives you a real experience like no other. Most of the cleaning and organizing games on the market are 2D, but this game brings you a 3D experience. At the beginning of the game, you can pick a cool tool. There are 5 levels in this game and you can pick a level to start your cleaning. You can move your position as well as use the cleaning tool by clicking on the buttons on the screen or by hitting the keyboard.

title: 12 Minute Escape
description: Repair the ancient portal and escape before time runs out! Defeat slimes, gather magical resources, build powerful structures, unlock new wizard characters, and survive exciting world events. Every minute brings new opportunities with Golden Rush, Treasure Hunt, and Wizard Frenzy. Plan your upgrades wisely, grow stronger, and see if you can escape within 12 minutes! Beware the Slime King!

title: The Basement isn't THAT haunted
description:
A puzzle game about finding things in a messy basement and avoiding paranormal danger.

As a cute little bunny you look through the boxes stored in the basement and try not to open the ones with ghosts inside.

title: Meteoheroes
description:
THE PLANET’S SUPERHEROES
Fulmen, Nix, Nubess, Pluvia, Thermo and Ventum are six children that one day find out that they have superpowers.
Train the skills and superpowers of each MeteoHeroe in the gym with six games of marksmanship, speed, ability, coordination, strength, and synchronization.

title: Traffic Light Simulator 3D
description:
"Traffic-Light simulator" is an immersive simulation game where players take on the role of a traffic controller tasked with managing the flow of vehicles through a bustling city intersection. Set against the backdrop of a dynamic urban landscape, players must strategically operate a traffic light to prevent congestion, accidents, and ensure smooth traffic flow.
With each passing level, the intensity and complexity of traffic increase, testing the player's decision-making skills and reflexes.

title: Gothic Knife
description: Test your skills in this classic knife-throwing arcade game. Your goal is to stick all knives into the rotating target without hitting the ones already there. The target spins faster and more unpredictably with each level. Every 3 levels, a unique boss battle awaits you! Master the combo system to get high scores and enjoy Gothic

title: Koko Loco Block Blast
description: Think fast, blast smart — can you beat your best score? Blast blocks, fit shapes, and outsmart the grid in this fast-paced puzzle challenge! Every move counts: clear space, chain combos, and keep the board from filling up. With smooth controls, colorful blocks, and quick rounds, it’s perfect for casual fun or deep strategy. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — how high can you climb the high score ladder?

title: Wonders of Egypt Match 2
description: Wonders of Egypt Match 2 returns with a brand-new Match-3 adventure in Ancient Egypt! Travel with your loyal Sphinx through pyramids, temples, palaces, and towering obelisks. Match 3+ sparkling gems to uncover treasures, artifacts, and hidden secrets. Conquer hundreds of fresh levels, complete tricky goals, and use powerful boosters when you need a helping hand. Earn dazzling rewards and prove your skills as the mysteries of the desert unfold in every chapter! Ready to play? Step in and match!

title: Fish Sort
description: Sort colorful fish, place them where they belong, and solve fun sea puzzles in a bright underwater game for kids and adults.

title: Steal Brainrot Original 3D
description: Buy rare animals—from the entry-level Nubini Pitzanini to Tralalelo Tralal and Los Tralaleritos. Place them in your base, create ideal conditions, and start earning! Each animal generates income ? and opens the door to new opportunities. Grow your collection, improve your infrastructure, experiment with your team composition, and increase your profits. Want more income? Buy new, rarer animals and build your financial empire.

title: Fish Love Pins
description: Fish Love Pins is a physics-based game that requires players to actively use their brains to figure out how to complete each level. The game is very easy to play, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty gradually increases.

title: Cat Sorter Puzzle
description:
A total cat chaos! These fluffy troublemakers have spread over different seats and are waiting for someone clever enough to stack them by color.

Use your focus and logical thinking to get the best results in this contemplative game.

title: Dead Faces Clone Online
description:
Dead Faces Clone Online is a horror, intrigue, investigation, and object collection game in a 3D game in the dark horror category. You can play it for free in your favorite browser.

You will control the main character, who is in a building with many strange things that are happening. Investigate, follow the instructions to find the items, don't be afraid, and solve each of the levels of this game.

title: Diep.io
description: Diep.io is a survival .io game where you control a circle armed with a cannon. The aim is simple: move around the map and destroy the other players whilst improving and upgrading your own circle.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Superhero Phone Simulator
description: Explore action-packed mini-games, customize your hero, and test your skills in fun challenges. Whether you enjoy racing, creativity, or exciting adventures, this app has everything you need for endless fun!

title: Untwist Road
description: Collect cylinders, roll out the road and overcome obstacles in this unique game. It is suitable for all fans of arcade games who like to test their skills and reactions. Try all the features of the game, unlock new levels and beat your records! You only need a few minutes to fully immerse yourself in this exciting game. Try it yourself!

title: Love In Style
description: Love In Style is a beauty dress-up game where you must prepare yourself for Valentine's day! Get creative and help the girls to pick the perfect kitchen outfits for baking a sweet treat for her boo.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Live 100 Days
description: Survive 100 days in a chaotic life simulation where every choice matters. Manage danger, resources, and unexpected events as you try to stay alive for as long as possible.

title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a creative and exciting puzzle game that combines drawing and rescue gameplay into one addictive experience. You become a bridge designer, using your finger to draw safe paths and complete thrilling rescue missions. Enter the car mode, draw a strong bridge to help a motor cross gaps, broken roads, and dangerous obstacles to reach the goal.

title: Hook Pin Jam
description: Hook Jam is an addictive puzzle game where you untangle and release hooks to clear the board and earn rewards. Each level challenges your logic and planning with increasingly complex layouts. Solve puzzles efficiently, unlock new stages, and test your problem-solving skills in this clever, satisfying brain game.

title: CS: Upgrade Gun
description: The weapon is alive and ready to go hunting! In this fast-paced launcher, you control a cannon that runs itself and shoots at targets. Collect boosters, improve their performance and last as long as possible. The further you go, the more action and explosions!

title: Jungle Solitaire
description: Jungle Spider Solitaire is an adaptation of the classic card game Spider Solitaire with a jungle theme. It is optimized for short games and encourages strategic planning of moves with an original system of collecting diamonds.

title: Hexa puzzle
description:
Stretch your mind and train your brain with this addictive block puzzle game. Can you solve all of the hundreds of free puzzles?

Put your mind and brain to work to solve the puzzle game by placing the unique hexagon pieces neatly into the puzzle grid. Merge each hexo shaped piece into the grid one by one. Similar to Tetris, they all need to fit together to complete the puzzle. You may need more time to match all the blocks into the super perfect spot - but that's fine, there are no time limit!

title: Gym Muscle Merge Tycoon
description: Gym Muscle: Merge Tycoon is an addictive game where you create your team of fighters and transform them into real muscle heroes. Connect fighters to strengthen their muscle mass, improve their characteristics, and earn profit. Participate in fighting tournaments to compete for cool rewards and become the most powerful fighter of all time!

title: Dynamons 7
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 7! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Tall Pines world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Crocynos, Huango, Cybeenyx, Aragonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Draw to Fish Fight
description: Are you ready? It's time to smack some fish with Skibidi! This fun and crazy game lets you dive into Skibidi's exciting adventure and discover his fish-smacking skills. Smack the fish that come your way and collect points. Avoid obstacles and collect bonuses to power up Skibidi. The more fish you smack, the higher your score! Share your high scores with friends and compete with them.

title: Jump Ball Classic
description: Jump Ball Classic is the best game to test your reflexes. Move your ball left and right to avoid obstacles and enjoy the thrilling moment! Once it hits, it will fail immediately. Concentrate and challenge for success!

title: Number Rush
description:
You can absorb smaller or equal numbers while avoiding obstacles.
If you collide with a number bigger than you, it's game over.
Make the largest number possible to break through the wall and get the treasure chest~!

title: Guess The Drawing
description: This is a casual puzzle game where you draw and I guess. Maybe you've played a game like that before, where someone draws on your back and you draw on the front, and then you see if you agree. If you like that kind of game, then this game is for you. In this game, you need to memorize what the person behind you draws.You can use the coins you get to buy the brushes you need. Come and experience this new and interesting game world.

title: No Pain No Gain - Ragdoll Sandbox
description: A ragdoll sandbox physics game where you place traps, cause pain, and earn coins for every hit. The more it hurts, the more you get.

title: Blox Fruits
description: Embark on an epic adventure across the seas in Blox Fruits, a Roblox MMORPG inspired by the world of One Piece. Choose your path as a Pirate or Marine, master powerful abilities granted by mystical Blox Fruits, and strive to become the strongest player in the game

title: Hawaii Match 6
description: Escape to paradise in Hawaii Match 6! Explore beautiful island landscapes while matching exotic fruits, flowers, and tropical treasures. Complete fun and challenging goals in limited moves by combining symbols and creating powerful bonuses. Unlock helpful boosters, discover hidden rewards, and enjoy a relaxing island adventure full of colorful puzzles. Play Hawaii Match 6 now and enjoy endless tropical fun!

title: Bouncy Bomb Buddies
description: Bouncy Bomb Buddies is a high-energy, sugary-sweet 1v1 artillery platformer where cute characters battle it out in vibrant, candy-colored arenas. Your goal? Bounce around platforms, grab falling bombs, and launch them at your opponent to be the last buddy standing! It combines fast-paced movement with tactical throwing physics and a best-of-5 rounds system to crown the supreme champion.

title: Volley Bean
description: Volley Bean is a simple and easy to learn volleyball game. With simple controls and fast paced gameplay volleyball never been more entertaining. The variety of boosts spawn randomly on the screen doubles the fun.

title: Circle Shooter Master
description: Circle Shooter Master is a cool and exciting game about destroying the boss in the circle. You run in circles, shoot the boss, get materials, build towers, defend roadblocks and grab things that fall on the circle. You have to watch out for the boss’s attack and kill him before he hurts you. Join the game now!

title: Delivery Chaos
description: Delivery Chaos is a fast-paced driving game where explosions turn every delivery into a challenge! Navigate through explosive mayhem, collecting waypoints to rack up coins and boost your score. Outmaneuver destruction, and unlock powerful new vehicles and exciting map areas. Can you survive the chaos and become the ultimate delivery driver?

title: Truck Simulator: Russia
description: In Truck Simulator: Russia you will drive a truck. As a driver, you will deliver cargoes to various cities and travel the open world. Unlock new types of goods to receive a greater reward for delivery. With the money you earn, you can buy a new truck or improve your trucks, as well as upgrade driver skills.

title: Mr. Mine
description: Mr. Mine is an addictive idle mining clicker arcade game that puts you in charge of building a mining empire from the ground up!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: City Banana Man Agent
description: Begin an interesting fighting experience in City Banana Man Agent! You'll play as a strange banana agent passing busy city streets. Choose a spot to land and start exploring this wonderful city.Find the target and complete the task. And show your driving skills. Equipped with many powerful weapons and shoot enemies. Aim your gun at the enemy and attack him.

title: Cube Combo
description: CubeCombo is a casual puzzle game. In this game, players need to use their wits by moving blocks with numbers, and merge the same blocks together until only one block is left, to complete the challenge. When only one number block is left in the panel or the target number block is synthesized, the current level is passed and a new level is opened.

title: 12-in-1 Solitaire
description:
Solitaire is one of the most popular – if not the most popular – card games in the world! Experience premium Solitaire gameplay at its best with 12 of the world's most popular Solitaire games!

Welcome to our latest & most comprehensive collection of the world's best & most popular Solitaire games! We included 12 of the most beloved Solitaire games in 1 comphrehensive collection, added helpful features appreciated by both Solitaire pros and amateurs alike.

title: The Wall
description:
Here's the Wall - thanks to it, you can gain a lot, but you can also lose a lot!
Bet on the zones, answer the questions and win the prizes that the balls will draw for you!

Our quiz contains the most puzzles among trivia games.
Feel real emotions, face the Wall!

title: Block Parkour Trials
description: Block Parkour Trials is a super fun and free-to-play parkour game. Your goal is to reach the portal at the finish line by skillfully jumping over obstacles. Have fun and enjoy the challenge!

title: Stick Hero Fight
description: Enter the most nervous stickman battles. In Stick Hero Fight, you as a mighty stickman hero. Fight through waves of enemies using incredible battle skills. This action game lets you upgrade your hero and unleash devastating attacks to dominate every fight! Use punches, weapons, and powerful skills to deliver deadly attacks.

title: SLIDE STONE
description: Horisontally slide the blocks and create a complete row across the board. Every time you slide a block and additional blocks are added from the bottom of the board. If you create multiple rows simultanepusly or create a row consecutively that becomes a COMBO! Good luck and let's aim for the high score!

title: Bowmasters
description: Bowmasters is a fun and action-packed game that combines creative physics with exciting Archery gameplay. Use different types of bows and weapons. Draw your weapon, judge the angle, and fire arrows to hit all enemies. The game shines with its physics-based mechanics, where timing, distance, and trajectory matter. You’ll need real skill and smart thinking to solve each shooting puzzle and land accurate hits. Every match feels different thanks to unique characters and varied weapons.

title: Soccer Euro Cup 2025
description:
Can you hear the deafening cheers of a mighty crowd? Get pumped for the Soccer Euro Cup 2025!

Pick your favorite country to represent and get ready for kickoff. Do your best to kick or headbutt the ball into your opponent's goal!

How many did you manage to score? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Pimple Squeeze
description: Dive into ASMR Pimple Pop, the ultimate stress-relief pimple popping game for casual fun! Squeeze, pop, and zap blackheads and pimples with satisfying ASMR sounds and juicy visuals. Enjoy quick arcade-style levels with combo bonuses and quirky faces to clean up. With smooth controls and gross-fun charm, this pimple pop arcade delivers unmatched satisfaction. Ready to pop? Download now and embrace the oddly addictive experience!

title: Hexa Sort 3D
description: Hexa Sort 3D mixes puzzle challenges, strategic matching and a satisfying merging experience.Involving clever puzzle-solving and logical manoeuvres, this game is ideal for those seeking a mental workout. As the levels progress, players will find the game both addictive and calming, striking the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Put your skills to the test with tasks such as sorting, stacking and merging hexagonal tiles.
